title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel
description:
# YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel



We are looking for a talented **YouTube Documentary Video Editor** to join a growing faceless YouTube channel.



Our videos are story-driven documentaries focused on **Canada, cities, regional identity, history, culture, politics, economics, rivalries, and major events**.



Typical videos will be approximately **20–40 minutes long**.



This is not a simple “put stock footage over a voiceover” editing job.



We are looking for an editor who understands **storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, visual variety, and documentary-style editing**.



## WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE



For each video, you will generally receive:



* Final voiceover

* Completed script

* Organized visual assets

* Archival photographs and footage

* B-roll

* Maps, charts, screenshots and other supporting materials

* Source information where relevant

* Editing instructions for important sequences



You will **not normally be expected to research the entire video from scratch**.



However, a strong editor should be capable of finding additional appropriate visuals when something is missing or when a better visual would significantly improve the scene.



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will turn the supplied materials into a polished, engaging YouTube documentary.



This includes:



* Editing the complete video around the voiceover

* Selecting the strongest available visuals for each narration beat

* Creating strong visual pacing

* Using archival photographs and footage effectively

* Adding maps, headlines, screenshots, documents and graphics where appropriate

* Creating simple motion graphics and animations

* Adding tasteful zooms, pans and movement to still photographs

* Using text and on-screen information when it strengthens the story

* Adding appropriate music and sound design

* Mixing audio properly

* Creating smooth transitions between sections

* Maintaining visual continuity and a consistent documentary style

* Finding supplementary visuals when necessary

* Delivering a finished video ready for YouTube



## THE EDITING STYLE



The editing should feel like a **modern YouTube documentary**, not a corporate presentation and not an over-edited TikTok video.



We value:



**Storytelling over effects.**



Every visual should help explain the story, establish a location or period, provide evidence, create emotion, or maintain viewer attention.



We do NOT want random stock footage inserted simply because something needs to appear on screen.



We also do not want excessive transitions, constant sound effects, unnecessary animation, or distracting editing tricks.



Good judgment matters.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have experience editing long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, video essays, history content, geography content, or similar storytelling formats.



You should understand:



* YouTube audience retention

* Documentary pacing

* Visual storytelling

* B-roll selection

* Archival imagery

* Music and sound design

* Motion graphics

* Maps and basic data visualization

* How to keep a 20–40 minute video visually interesting without making it exhausting



You should also be comfortable receiving detailed feedback and making revisions.



## SOFTWARE



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform is acceptable.



After Effects or similar motion-graphics capability is an advantage.



## VERY IMPORTANT: COPYRIGHT



You must understand basic copyright and licensing requirements.



Do not download random images or footage from Google, YouTube, TikTok,
 or other websites and insert them into our videos without authorization.



Any additional assets you source must have appropriate licensing or usage rights, and the source must be documented.



## PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **small paid editing test of approximately 2–3 minutes**.



The same voiceover, script and asset package will be provided to shortlisted candidates so that editing quality can be compared fairly.



The test will evaluate:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Visual selection

* Music

* Sound design

* Graphics

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions

* Overall professional quality



## LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to become an ongoing position.



We are building a library of documentary videos and expect to publish consistently.



If your work is excellent, there will be regular projects available.



We value editors who become familiar with the channel's visual language and improve with each video.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to **2–3 of your best long-form YouTube edits**.

3. At least one example involving documentary, history, geography, politics, economics, video essay, or similar storytelling content if available.

4. Tell us exactly what parts of those videos you personally edited.

5. Tell us what editing software you use.

6. Tell us approximately how long you would need to edit a polished 25–30 minute documentary when the voiceover, script and most visual assets are supplied.

7. Tell us your expected rate for a 25–30 minute finished video.

8. Confirm whether you are willing to complete a paid 2–3 minute editing test.



**To show that you read the entire job post, begin your application with the words:**



**“DOCUMENTARY EDITOR”**



Applications that do not include these words may not be reviewed.



Please do not send 15–20 portfolio links. Send only your strongest and most relevant work.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term working relationship**, not simply complete one video.

description:
High Point Financial is a U.S.-based business tax, accounting, bookkeeping, and payroll firm serving small and midsized businesses, with a strong focus on restaurants and hospitality clients.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper who can take ownership of client books with limited day-to-day training. This is a long-term part-time position with the potential to grow into full-time work as our client base expands.



This is not an entry-level data-entry position. We need someone who understands U.S. bookkeeping, can identify problems before they become larger issues, and can produce clean, accurate financial records.



Responsibilities:



• Complete monthly bookkeeping and month-end close procedures in QuickBooks Online

• Categorize and review transactions accurately

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant processors, and clearing accounts

• Prepare and review Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

• Support accounts payable and accounts receivable tasks

• Record and reconcile payroll journal entries and payroll liabilities

• Work with restaurant-related transactions, including sales, tips, food costs, merchant fees, delivery platforms, and sales-tax-related accounts

• Reconcile POS and third-party delivery activity, including Clover, Toast, Square, DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub

• Identify missing information, duplicate transactions, unusual activity, uncategorized items, and reconciliation discrepancies

• Clearly document questions and issues for the U.S.-based team

• Maintain organized client files and follow established procedures

• Help create and improve bookkeeping procedures as the company grows



Required qualifications:



• At least 3 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience for U.S.-based clients

• Strong QuickBooks Online experience, including transaction categorization, reconciliations, cleanup work, and month-end close

• Experience preparing and reviewing financial statements

• Experience with restaurant, bar, hospitality, retail, or other high-transaction businesses

• Working knowledge of merchant processing, POS systems, delivery platforms, tips, payroll entries, and sales-tax-related accounts

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently

• Professional written and spoken English

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a dependable work environment

• Ability to handle confidential financial information professionally



Preferred qualifications:



• QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

• Experience with Clover, Toast, Square, Shogo, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, or similar platforms

• Experience working for a U.S. bookkeeping or accounting firm

• Familiarity with QuickBooks Desktop

• Experience with catch-up bookkeeping or cleanup projects



Schedule and compensation:



• Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week

• Flexible schedule with occasional availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

• $950 USD per month, equivalent to approximately $11 per hour at 20 hours per week

• Long-term position with the opportunity for increased hours and full-time work based on performance and company growth

• Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical bookkeeping assessment



How to apply:



Begin your application with the word “CLOSEBOOKS” so we know you read the full posting.



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. The number of years you have worked with QuickBooks Online

3. The number of U.S.-based clients you have supported

4. The number and type of restaurant or hospitality clients you have handled

5. The POS systems, merchant processors, and delivery platforms you have reconciled

6. Your current availability and desired hourly or monthly rate

7. A 2–4 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your bookkeeping experience



In your Loom video, please discuss:



• Your QuickBooks Online and U.S. accounting experience

• Your restaurant or hospitality bookkeeping experience

• The most difficult reconciliation or bookkeeping issue you have handled

• Your normal month-end close process

• Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role



Please do not show confidential client information, passwords, or private financial records in your video. 

****Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.****

title: Podcast Production Support
description:
We're looking for a freelance podcast producer to handle end-to-end production support, from raw recording through to finished episode and social media clips. This is ongoing, recurring work tied to our weekly publishing schedule, not a one-off project.



Responsibilities

Edit raw audio and/or video recordings into a polished, publish-ready episode (cutting dead air, filler words, and mistakes; leveling and cleaning up audio)

Add intro/outro music and any standard episode branding elements

Upload finished episodes to our podcast hosting platform and/or YouTube

Write or refine episode titles and show notes

Cut 3 to 5 short-form clips per episode optimized for social media (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.), including captions

Design simple episode graphics or thumbnails as needed

Keep production on schedule to hit our weekly Tuesday publish date

Requirements

Proven experience producing and editing podcasts (please share samples or a portfolio)

Comfortable with audio/video editing software (e.g. Descript, Adobe Audition, Premiere, or similar)

Experience cutting long-form content into short-form social clips

Reliable turnaround time and strong communication

Detail-oriented, especially with audio quality and consistency across episodes



Nice to Have

Experience with podcast hosting platforms (Buzzsprout, Libsyn, etc.)

Basic graphic design skills (Canva or similar) for thumbnails and social graphics

Interest in or familiarity with sustainability, climate, or the nonprofit/municipal space

Experience batching workflows for a recurring weekly show

title: CLNR Studios | Colorist
description:
## Freelance Colorist — Custom LUT Creation & Color Grading



**Company:** CLNR Studios  

**Engagement:** Freelance / project-based  

**Location:** Remote  

**Compensation:** Competitive; based on experience and project scope



CLNR Studios is seeking an experienced freelance colorist for ongoing, project-based work. We’re looking for someone with an exceptional eye, strong technical expertise, and the ability to create distinctive visual treatments across commercial, branded, narrative, and social content.



This is a gig-based opportunity for a dependable creative partner we can call on whenever a project requires professional color grading or custom LUT development. We offer a substantial budget for exceptional talent and consistently polished, high-end work.



### Responsibilities



- Professionally color-correct and grade footage

- Create technical and creative custom LUTs

- Establish cohesive looks across multiple cameras and lighting environments

- Perform shot matching, skin-tone refinement, and secondary corrections

- Collaborate with directors, editors, and producers to translate references into finished visual treatments

- Prepare grades for web, social, broadcast, and other delivery formats

- Maintain organized project files and reliable color-management workflows

- Complete revisions efficiently and within agreed timelines



### Requirements



- Advanced proficiency in DaVinci Resolve

- Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and round-trip workflows

- Proven experience creating custom LUTs

- Thorough understanding of color science, color management, log formats, codecs, scopes, and delivery standards

- Excellent judgment around exposure, contrast, skin tones, color separation, and visual consistency

- Ability to match footage across different cameras and shooting conditions

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to exceptional work

- Dependable communication and deadline management

- Ability to work independently and accommodate fast turnarounds when required



Experience with HDR, ACES, commercials, music videos, fashion, beauty, and remote review platforms is a plus.



### To Apply



Please submit:



- A color-grading reel or portfolio

- Before-and-after examples, if available

- Examples of custom LUTs or looks you’ve developed

- A brief description of your workflow and technical setup

- Your availability, typical turnaround time, and project or day rate

- A note clarifying your role in each submitted project



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid test using footage supplied by CLNR Studios.



We’re looking to build a long-term relationship with a hardworking, highly skilled colorist—not simply fill a single project. If you combine refined creative taste with technical precision and reliable execution, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Freelance Video Editor
description:
# Freelance Video Editor



**Type:** Freelance / Contract

**Compensation:** $500–$1,000 CAD per month

**Work Style:** Ongoing monthly editing support



## Role Purpose



Hot Tanks is looking for a reliable freelance Video Editor to turn approved raw footage into clear, professional, brand-consistent video content.



You will work with footage created by the Hot Tanks TEAM and prepare finished video assets for platforms such as Instagram,
, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and the Hot Tanks website.



This is primarily an editing role. Hot Tanks manages the content strategy, planning, approvals, scheduling, and publishing.



## What You Will Edit



Content may include:



* Educational and expert videos

* Client testimonials and review videos

* Short testimonial clips

* Installation and project footage

* Before-and-after videos

* Field B-roll

* Technician and TEAM introductions

* Service-quality and Signature Standard videos

* Client journey and “what to expect” videos

* Community content

* Behind-the-scenes and TEAM culture content



## Core Responsibilities



You will:



* Review raw footage provided by Hot Tanks.

* Select the strongest usable moments.

* Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated takes, and unusable footage.

* Create clean, natural edits with strong pacing.

* Keep speakers sounding natural and human.

* Add approved:



  * Logos

  * Lower thirds

  * Captions

  * Text overlays

  * Service labels

  * Transition cards

  * End frames

  * Calls to action

* Make basic adjustments to:



  * Audio

  * Exposure

  * Colour

  * Framing

* Add B-roll when it improves the story or explanation.

* Create vertical and horizontal versions when required.

* Create thumbnails when required.

* Export videos in the correct dimensions, resolution, and file format.

* Keep project files and finished exports organized.

* Complete reasonable revisions based on consolidated Hot Tanks feedback.



## Common Video Formats



Typical work may include:



### 9:16 Vertical Video



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts



### 16:9 Horizontal Video



* YouTube Main Videos

* Website videos

*
 native video



### Other Common Deliverables



* 15–30 second clips

* 30–60 second short-form videos

* 1–3 minute videos

* Thumbnails

* Occasional longer-form videos when required



Some source footage may require more than one finished format.



For example, the same source footage may be edited into both a vertical and horizontal version.



## Editing Style



Hot Tanks content should feel:



* Professional

* Clear

* Warm

* Trustworthy

* Clean

* Calm

* Natural

* Consistent



The goal is not to make every video flashy or heavily produced.



The finished video should help the viewer feel:



* “I understand what they are explaining.”

* “These people know what they are doing.”

* “They seem professional.”

* “I would feel comfortable having them in my home.”



## We Prefer



* Clean cuts

* Natural pacing

* Easy-to-read captions

* Simple graphics

* Consistent branding

* Strong opening moments

* Useful B-roll

* Minimal unnecessary effects

* Clear endings and calls to action



## Please Avoid



* Excessive animation

* Distracting transitions

* Aggressive zooming

* Overused sound effects

* Excessive text

* Meme-style editing unless specifically requested

* Trend-heavy editing that weakens the Hot Tanks brand

* Editing that changes the meaning of what someone said



## Brand Protection



The Video Editor must follow approved Hot Tanks brand assets, templates, and editing standards.



Do not independently:



* Change logos.

* Change brand colours.

* Rewrite approved company promises or standards.

* Create new company claims.

* Change the meaning of a client testimonial.

* Add pricing, guarantees, technical claims, or promotional language that was not provided or approved.

* Publish content directly unless specifically authorized.



Hot Tanks controls final approval and publishing.



## Monthly Work Structure



Work will normally be provided in organized batches rather than as isolated one-off videos.



The monthly workload may include a mix of:



* Short-form videos

* Simple edits

* Alternate versions of the same source footage

* Testimonial edits

* Educational videos

* Mid-length videos

* Occasional longer-form pieces

* Thumbnails



The mix and volume of work may vary slightly from month to month within the agreed scope.



The agreed monthly flat rate covers the regular editing workload established between Hot Tanks and the selected editor.



One consolidated revision round per assignment is normally expected.



## What Hot Tanks Provides



Hot Tanks will provide:



* Raw footage

* Content direction

* Required dimensions

* Brand assets

* Reference examples when needed

* Required text, labels, or end frames

* Editing instructions

* Consolidated feedback



The editor is not expected to independently create the overall content strategy.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person should have:



* Strong short-form video editing skills.

* Good pacing and storytelling judgement.

* Experience editing vertical and horizontal video.

* Experience preparing social-media-ready content.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Reliable file organization.

* Strong written English for captions and on-screen text.

* Ability to follow templates, instructions, and standards consistently.

* Ability to receive feedback and apply it without repeatedly making the same corrections.

* Reliable communication.

* Reliable turnaround.

* Good judgement about when to cut and when to let a moment breathe.



Experience with home services, trades, testimonials, educational content, or local-business marketing is helpful but not required.



## Software



You may use professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Similar professional editing software



We care more about the quality and consistency of the finished work than the specific software used.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful Video Editor:



* Learns the Hot Tanks editing style.

* Delivers clean, publication-ready videos.

* Requires fewer corrections over time.

* Keeps branding consistent.

* Meets agreed deadlines.

* Keeps files organized.

* Communicates clearly.

* Handles repeatable monthly production reliably.

* Turns raw footage into useful finished assets the Hot Tanks TEAM can publish confidently.



## Compensation



**Monthly Compensation Range: $500–$1,000 CAD**



This is an ongoing freelance/contract editing role.



The final monthly rate will be agreed upon based on:



* Experience

* Editing quality

* Efficiency

* Ability to follow the Hot Tanks editing standard

* Communication and reliability

* Agreed monthly workload



We are looking for a flat monthly arrangement that reflects the agreed workload rather than pricing every individual video separately.



## Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test editing project using actual Hot Tanks footage.



The purpose of the test is to allow both Hot Tanks and the editor to determine whether the working relationship is a good fit before entering into an ongoing monthly arrangement.



The paid test will evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Pacing and storytelling

* Ability to follow instructions

* Brand consistency

* Caption and on-screen text accuracy

* Attention to detail

* Communication

* Turnaround time and reliability

* Ability to apply feedback



The test project will be compensated at an agreed project rate before the work begins.



Completion of the paid test does not guarantee an ongoing contract. Candidates whose work is a strong fit may be offered the monthly freelance editing role.



This role is focused on turning approved Hot Tanks footage into strong, consistent, publication-ready video content.

title: Virtual Assistant (Full-Time, Remote — Philippines)
description:
Executive Assistant / Client & Social Media Coordinator



I run a fast-moving creative production company specializing in video production, content, and creative work. I’m looking for a smart, reliable VA who can become my right hand in the business.



This is not a role where I want to assign every small task every day.



I need someone who can learn how my business works, stay on top of projects and clients, notice what needs attention, follow up without being reminded, and help keep everything moving while I focus on creative direction, production, sales, and growing the company.



If you’re calm, proactive, extremely organized, resourceful, and an excellent communicator, you’ll thrive here.



Your Responsibilities



Executive / Administrative



* Manage calendar, scheduling and reminders

* Help manage inbox and important follow-ups

* Keep my daily and weekly priorities organized

* Research vendors, services, travel, crew, etc.

* Organize documents, Dropbox/Drive and business information

* Handle general administrative tasks and problem-solving



Clients & Projects



* Track active projects, deadlines and deliverables

* Communicate professionally with clients

* Follow up for feedback, assets, approvals and payments

* Coordinate with editors, videographers and other team members

* Make sure projects don’t fall through the cracks

* Maintain CRM and track current, past and prospective clients

* Help onboard new clients



Social Media & Content



* Help manage our social media/content calendar

* Schedule and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook

* Write/research captions, hooks, hashtags, titles and keywords

* Coordinate with our editors/content team

* Research trends and content opportunities

* Track performance and identify what’s working

* Help organize our existing library of video/photo content



Marketing & Business Development



* Research potential clients and opportunities

* Build targeted prospect lists

* Find appropriate decision-makers/contact information

* Follow up with previous clients and leads

* Assist with email/DM outreach

* Keep outreach organized in our CRM

* Help develop new ways to generate business



Who I’m Looking For



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Proactive — you don’t wait to be told everything

* Strong professional communication

* Comfortable communicating with clients

* Resourceful and good at figuring things out

* Calm when multiple projects are happening at once

* Reliable and consistent

* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

* Able to prioritize what’s important without constant supervision

* Interested in growing into a larger role as the company grows



Big Plus If You Have Experience With



* Executive/personal assistance

* Client or account management

* Social media management

* Lead generation / client outreach

* Creative agencies or video production

* CRM systems

* ClickUp / Asana / Notion / Trello

* Google Workspace

* Metricool

* Canva

* ChatGPT / AI tools



You do not need to be an expert in everything above. I’m looking more for intelligence, initiative, communication, organization and willingness to learn.



Hours



Starting part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours and potentially become full-time if it’s a great fit and the workload supports it.



Hours & Work Style



Starting part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger/full-time role.



I care much more about productivity and results than watching a clock. I’m not looking for someone to sit online for a certain number of hours just to log time. If you’re organized, efficient, and get your responsibilities handled properly, that’s what matters to me.



I value ownership, communication, and results over hours worked. The goal is to make sure clients are taken care of, projects keep moving, content gets posted, follow-ups happen, and important tasks don’t fall through the cracks.



I want someone who works efficiently and eventually understands the business well enough to know what needs to happen without constantly waiting for instructions.





How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your VA/executive assistant experience

3. Any client/account management experience

4. Your social media experience and examples of accounts/content you’ve worked on

5. Any lead generation/outreach experience

6. Your hourly/monthly rate

7. Your availability and preferred working hours

8. Tell me about a time you noticed something needed to be done and handled it without your boss/client asking you to do it

description:
***IMPORTANT: Hi! My name is Atisha Patel, VP of Customer Success & Operations at Boom. To apply for this job, please fill out the application form: 



You can also reach me at 
 be working most closely with Joven Verano, our Customer Support Operations Team Manager, who is based in the Philippines and can be reached at 
 CC 
 on all
s.



COMPANY AND OPPORTUNITY 

Boom is building the agentic operational layer for the residential real estate industry. Property managers and landlords handle significant manual, but critical work that requires intelligence and accuracy: screening applicants, chasing income documents, reviewing reports, answering prospect calls, and often get the same questions a hundred times a week. We're replacing that with software and AI agents that do the work, and a human team that makes sure it's done right.

Our products include BoomScreen (tenant screening: identity verification, income verification, credit, criminal, eviction and rental history reports) and BoomCRM (leads, listings, and AI leasing agents), alongside BoomReport, our rent reporting product. We are a growing team led by top tier investors, a second-time founder CEO, and people with experience across real estate, consulting, and AI. We ship new features every day.



We're seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our support and operations team. This is a real customer support role -you'll be the person who figures out why an applicant's ID verification is stuck and get them to the finish line, walk a property manager through a screening template, and write up a bug ticket in Jira to help our engineers fix the issue when something is actually broken. You'll primarily be using our customer support platform, Fin (Formerly Intercom), Slack, Teams, and Google Chat, where you will support applicants, leads, and property managers with first-hand questions. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve how you support our customers, quickly and accurately, with empathy. Additionally, our chat is AI-first and escalates to humans, and part of your job is being the human who catches what the AI gets wrong. We're excited to have a work relationship where you learn from us as much as we learn from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO 

This role is roughly half consumer support and half business customer support, plus ad-hoc project work.

Supporting consumers (Leads, applicants, renters)

Help applicants get through the application itself - identity verification retries and failed uploads, income document submissions (bank statements, paystubs, W-2s), bank and payroll linking, application status questions

Explain next steps and respond to questions clearly and calmly, including sensitive topics like credit, criminal, and eviction records

Handle rent reporting questions (enrollment, verification timelines, credit bureau reporting)

Proactive outreach to applicants who are stuck mid-application, by chat,
, SMS, or phone

Repushing applications when needed, making data corrections (e.g. Name changes)

Supporting business customers (property managers and partners)

Help property managers set up the Boom platform: screening templates and criteria, roles and permissions, application management, running reports, etc.

Troubleshoot technical issues related to tenant screening - For example, when data is not syncing from Boom to a Property Manager’s database

Enter “Guest cards” as needed in the property management system when needed, transferring information from applications

Investigate issues in our admin tools and partner portal before escalating, and give partners a clear answer on what happened and what's next

Work in shared partner channels (Slack, Google Chat, Microsoft Teams) alongside our Customer Success Managers

Diagnosing and escalating bugs

Diagnose the problem immediately, resolve it yourself where you can, explain it in plain language to the customer, and create a well-documented ticket when it needs engineering. Think about how this can be improved moving forward.

A good ticket from you includes the issue, the customer, the relevant admin and portal links, the partner ID, and screenshots or recordings. We'll train you on our process and how to write tickets, and then expect to have you continue that quality

Know the difference between "this needs a bug ticket" and "this is a one-off request" — and know when not to file at all

Ad-hoc projects

Data gathering and research (vendor and competitor research, conference preparation, searching on various websites to understand which softwares are used, and light data analysis)

Data entry and bulk configuration work in our admin tools and partner portal

File creation and spreadsheet work (trackers, enrollment files, audit lists)

Reviewing applications and leads, app store and social review responses, and other one-off projects as they come up



REQUIREMENTS

Must have worked in a customer support role before. This is not an entry-level position

Near-native English, written and verbal. Our support includes chat,
, and voice, and you will be on the phone with US customers

Excellent communication skills. You can explain a technical problem in simple terms and explain exactly which steps you took, and well as expected verses current behavior.

Ability to diagnose, resolve, explain, and ticket technical problems. You investigate before you escalate, and you write up what you found

Ultra high responsiveness across many different communication channels. Our target is under 2 minutes on live chat, and you'll be moving between Intercom, Slack,
, phone, and partner channels all shift. If you go quiet, this role won't work

Comfortable using a support platform. We use Intercom (very similar to Zendesk) inbox, macros, tagging, help center articles

Comfortable working with AI tools. We use Claude in our support team, and you'll be reviewing and correcting AI-suggested responses, not just sending them

Attention to detail. Much of this work involves sensitive consumer data and regulated reports where accuracy matters

Open to change - processes and product change weekly at a startup, and you have to be comfortable with that

Unafraid to ask for help. We're happy to train you and help with problems, but going silent is unacceptable

Ability to work independently, organized, and good at time management

Fast, stable, reliable internet connection, and a quiet place to take calls

Computer specs of at least an Intel i5 processor (or equivalent AMD) and 8GB RAM

Experience with Fin, Google, Teams, and Slack is a plus



OUR TECH STACK INCLUDES

Fin (Intercom) — customer chat,
, SMS, help center, and our AI chat agent (

Slack / Zoom — internal communication

Google Workspace — Sheets, Docs, Gmail, Google Chat

Microsoft Teams Chat

Jira / Confluence — tickets and documentation

Claude — AI assistance & knowledge

Boom Admin and Partner Portal — our internal tools



TRAINING & TEAMING

We have a team of about 30 support team members in the Philippines, with Philippines-based team leads. You will not be figuring this out alone

Your first week in onboarding: tools setup, a full product overview across BoomScreen, BoomCRM, and BoomReport, our daily ops rhythm, and introductions from our leadership team. You'll also shadow experienced teammates on live queues before you own work yourself.

Ongoing training runs on recorded walkthroughs, written SOPs, and direct coaching from your team lead. Joven and our team leads run daily stand-ups and are available on Slack throughout your shift



WORKLOAD & DAYS/TIMES OF WORK

We'll start on a 1-month fully paid trial (we both see how we work together)

~45 hours per week to start

We staff support 7 days a week across multiple shifts, including overnight. Primary coverage is Monday - Friday, 10am - 7pm New York time, and we are also very interested in candidates who can cover overnight shifts and/or at least 1 day of weekend coverage. Tell us in your application what shifts you can commit to

Select US holidays are off; Christmas and New Year's Day are paid non-working days



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$4-5 per hour, with the opportunity to increase as you take on more responsibility

13th month bonus, prorated to the months and hours you've worked at Boom (e.g. if you've been at Boom less than a full year and/or are working less than 40 hours)

Payroll frequency: Every 2 weeks



HOW TO APPLY

Complete the application at this link:

If selected to move forward, you can expect a few short skill tests (a typing test, a quick written communication exercise, and a short research task) before an interview. They're designed to be quick and show us how you actually work, so will be recorded.

title: Senior AutoCAD Drafter & Project Coordinator – Architectural Metalwork
description:
We are an Australian metalwork company seeking an experienced Senior AutoCAD Drafter and Project Coordinator to join our team remotely on a full-time basis.



The primary responsibility of this role is producing accurate and practical AutoCAD 2D shop drawings for architectural and structural metalwork. The successful applicant must also be capable of independently coordinating projects and communicating professionally with clients, architects, engineers, builders and other consultants.



Our typical scope includes:



* Balustrades and handrails

* Privacy and decorative screens

* Louvres and sunshades

* Gates and fences

* Awnings and pergolas

* Façade elements and architectural metalwork

* General structural steel and aluminium components



Key responsibilities:



* Prepare general arrangement, fabrication and installation drawings using AutoCAD 2D

* Interpret architectural, structural and consultant drawings

* Develop practical connection, fixing, fabrication and installation details

* Identify clashes, discrepancies, constructability issues and missing information

* Prepare and manage RFIs, drawing registers, material schedules and transmittals

* Revise drawings promptly based on client and consultant comments

* Coordinate shop-drawing submissions, reviews and approvals

* Communicate professionally with clients, architects, engineers and builders

* Attend and actively participate in online design and coordination meetings

* Prepare meeting minutes and follow up outstanding actions

* Resolve design and coordination matters independently wherever possible

* Manage assigned projects from initial documentation through to shop-drawing approval

* Maintain organised project records and correspondence

* Assist with general project administration

* Occasionally assist with quantity take-offs and estimating when drafting workloads are lighter



The successful applicant must not simply copy information from architectural or structural drawings. You must be able to review the entire design, identify potential problems and produce coordinated drawings that can be practically manufactured and installed.



Mandatory qualifications and experience:



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture or another relevant discipline

* Strong professional experience using AutoCAD 2D

* Previous drafting experience in architectural metalwork, façades, balustrades, louvres, screens, aluminium or structural steel

* Good understanding of fabrication, connections and installation requirements

* Ability to work with Bluebeam Revu

* Professional written and spoken English

* Confidence communicating directly with clients, architects, engineers and builders

* Ability to attend and actively participate in online coordination meetings

* Ability to manage assigned projects and resolve issues with minimal supervision

* Strong organisational and project administration skills

* Exceptional attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

* Ability to produce drawings quickly without compromising quality

* Excellent responsiveness during agreed working hours

* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Availability to work hours that provide reasonable overlap with Sydney business hours



Software requirements:



The successful applicant must have their own computer and access to a recent, properly licensed version of AutoCAD. AutoCAD software and licensing will not be provided by the company.



Applicants must also be able to use Bluebeam Revu confidently. A Bluebeam licence may be provided if required.



Experience with Revit, SketchUp and estimating will be considered an advantage but is not essential.



This is a long-term, full-time remote position. The right person will be trusted to manage assigned projects independently and will have opportunities to take on greater project coordination and estimating responsibilities based on their performance and capability.



To apply, please provide:



1. Your CV

2. Details of your university degree

3. Examples of relevant shop drawings or a portfolio

4. Details of your metalwork or façade drafting experience

5. Examples of projects you have coordinated directly with clients and consultants

6. Your level of AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Revit and SketchUp experience

7. Your project administration and estimating experience

8. Confirmation that you have access to a recent licensed version of AutoCAD

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. Your availability to commence



Shortlisted applicants will be given a drafting and coordination assessment to demonstrate their technical understanding, speed, accuracy, drawing quality, attention to detail and communication skills.

title: Remote Automotive Collision Estimator / Service Advisor & Parts Coordinator / CCC ONE TEKMETERIC
description:
Remote Automotive Collision Estimator / Service Advisor & Parts Coordinator



Full-Time | $950 USD/Month | Remote | California Automotive Shops



We are looking for a full-time Remote Automotive Collision Estimator / Service Advisor & Parts Coordinator to help manage two automotive shops in California: a collision/body shop and a mechanical repair shop.



THIS IS NOT A GENERAL VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION.



CCC ONE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have real experience using CCC ONE and understand collision repair estimating. If you have never worked with CCC ONE, please do not apply.



Experience with Tekmetric is a plus, but NOT required. We can train the right candidate on Tekmetric.



Compensation & Schedule



Starting Pay: $950 USD per month



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working California/Pacific Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term position with the opportunity for increased compensation based on performance and responsibilities.



Your Responsibilities



You will help manage the front-office operations of both shops.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Answer phone calls for both businesses

* Schedule customers and appointments

* Provide customers with repair updates

* Follow up on estimates and approvals

* Communicate with insurance companies and adjusters

* Create and update estimates in CCC ONE

* Prepare and track collision supplements

* Review estimates and insurance paperwork

* Keep collision repair files organized

* Eventually learn and work inside Tekmetric

* Create mechanical repair estimates from technician recommendations

* Send estimates and obtain customer approvals

* Keep repair orders updated

* Follow vehicles from drop-off through completion



Parts Sourcing & Ordering



You will also be responsible for helping source and order parts for both shops.



This includes:



* Use VIN and vehicle information to identify the correct parts

* Source OEM, aftermarket, recycled and used parts

* Contact our regular vendors

* Compare prices between vendors

* Search eBay Motors and other approved online sources

* Compare price, shipping, delivery time, condition, warranty and return policy

* Verify correct fitment before purchasing

* Find the best overall deal — not simply the cheapest part

* Place approved parts orders

* Record purchases under the correct repair order

* Track shipments

* Follow up on delayed parts

* Handle returns and incorrect parts

* Match vendor invoices with repair orders



We want someone who understands that saving $30 on a part is not worth delaying a repair for five additional days.



Bills & Basic Bookkeeping



You will help:



* Enter vendor bills

* Organize receipts

* Match bills and parts purchases to repair orders

* Track outstanding customer balances

* Track bills that need to be paid

* Perform basic QuickBooks Online tasks

* Maintain organized records

* Provide management with weekly reports



QuickBooks experience is preferred but not required.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have:



* Previous CCC ONE experience

* Collision estimating experience

* Knowledge of automotive parts

* Understanding of collision repair procedures

* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Experience communicating with customers

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet professional workspace

* Ability to work California/Pacific Time hours



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a major plus:



* Tekmetric

* QuickBooks Online

* PartsTech

* Nexpart

* RepairLink

* Mitchell

* Insurance supplements

* U.S. insurance companies

* Mechanical service advising

* Automotive parts purchasing

* eBay Motors

* OEM / aftermarket / recycled parts



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic application.



Start your application with:



CCC ONE 950



Then answer ALL of the following:



1. CCC ONE Experience



How many years have you used CCC ONE?



What type of shop did you work for?



What did you personally do inside CCC ONE?



Did you write estimates yourself?



Did you write supplements?



Did you communicate with insurance adjusters?



2. Collision Estimating Test



Briefly explain what you would check when writing an estimate for a vehicle with front-end collision damage.



3. Parts Experience



Explain how you would find the correct replacement headlight for a 2021 Toyota Camry.



Where would you look?



How would you verify fitment?



How would you decide between OEM, aftermarket, recycled and used?



4. Other Software



Tell us whether you have experience with:



* Tekmetric

* QuickBooks

* PartsTech

* Nexpart

* RepairLink

* Mitchell



It is OK if you have never used Tekmetric. We can train you.



5. VOICE RECORDING — REQUIRED



Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Then pretend you are answering this customer phone call:



“Hi, I’m calling to check on the status of my car. I dropped it off three days ago and nobody has called me.”



Respond exactly as you would if you were working for our shop.



6. Work Hours



Confirm that you can work full-time during California/Pacific Time business hours.



7. Internet



Send a screenshot of your internet speed test.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who can eventually become an important part of our operation — not simply someone who completes assigned tasks.



You should be organized, dependable, comfortable speaking with American customers, knowledgeable about collision repair and able to work independently.



Your primary expertise should be CCC ONE and collision estimating.



We will teach the right person our specific procedures and how we use Tekmetric for the mechanical side of the business.



Starting salary: $950 USD/month

Full-time

Long-term position

Décalage Solutions is building a small, skilled, values-aligned remote core team. We are recruiting for multiple paid positions across several areas of the business.



This is not one position requiring one person to perform every function listed below. We are looking for professionals with genuine expertise in different areas. We would rather hire several people with demonstrated depth in their respective fields than one person who claims to do everything.



Opportunities may be part-time, project-based, or ongoing, depending on the function, current business needs, and each applicant’s demonstrated ability.



Compensation ranges from $8 to $15 USD per hour, depending on the role, experience, and demonstrated level of skill.



These opportunities are open only to women and transgender applicants.



Across every position, we want professionals who communicate directly, think critically, recognize problems, recommend solutions, take responsibility for their work, and care about the success of the company.



ABOUT DÉCALAGE SOLUTIONS



Décalage Solutions is a feminist company serving women who are creating social, political, and community change.



Our growing business includes private advisory and coaching, online education, community programming, retreats, speaking, writing, content creation, conscious travel, partnerships, and other values-led projects.



We are building a financially successful business without separating commercial success from political and ethical responsibility.



WHAT WE STAND FOR



Our work is grounded in intersectional feminism.



This means we understand that gender inequality cannot be separated from racism, colonialism, class, disability, sexuality, gender identity, migration, economic inequality, and other systems of power.



Our values include:



* Feminism that challenges patriarchy rather than helping individual women succeed at the expense of others

* Anti-racism and an active commitment to confronting white supremacy

* Anti-colonial practice and respect for Indigenous sovereignty, knowledge, and self-determination

* Palestinian liberation and meaningful commitment to the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement

* LGBTQ+ inclusion and respect for people of all sexual orientations and gender identities

* Disability justice and accessibility

* Economic and labour justice

* Human rights, collective liberation, and community responsibility

* Ethical consumption and corporate accountability

* Trauma-informed, anti-oppressive, and non-exploitative ways of working

* Respect for women’s autonomy, expertise, bodies, choices, and leadership

* Recognition that no person’s liberation should depend upon the oppression, exploitation, or disposability of another community



We do not practise a feminism that centres only privileged women, treats individual corporate success as liberation, ignores racism and colonialism, excludes transgender people, or remains silent about genocide and state violence.



This is not a politically neutral workplace.



Identity alone does not establish values alignment. Being a woman or transgender does not automatically mean that someone understands or supports feminism, intersectionality, anti-racism, anti-colonial practice, Palestinian liberation, LGBTQ+ rights, or BDS.



Applicants must understand these commitments, take them seriously, and demonstrate how they would affect their actual work.



AREAS IN WHICH WE ARE RECRUITING



We are recruiting professionals with demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:



* Operations and project management

* Executive assistance

* Administrative and virtual assistance

* Launch strategy and coordination

* Funnel implementation and testing

*
 marketing and automation

* Copywriting and sales-page support

* Social-media strategy, management, and scheduling

* Video editing and content production

* Systems, standard operating procedures, and workflow development

* Client experience and customer support

* Retreat and event coordination

* Partnership, sponsorship, and affiliate development

* Travel, venue, and hospitality coordination

* Website, technology, and platform support

* Contractor and team coordination

* Progress reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking

*Bookkeeping, accounting, and cross-border financial compliance, including Canadian, U.S., and Paraguayan requirements, with the ability and willingness to research additional jurisdictions as needed



We are not looking for one person to perform every function.



Do not claim that you can perform everything listed. Identify the areas in which you have genuine professional competence and provide evidence of what you have accomplished.



Applicants must explain:



* What they can perform independently at a professional level

* What they can perform with direction

* What they are currently learning

* What they are not qualified to perform

* What measurable results they have previously produced



Honest self-assessment is part of professional competence.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for people who:



* Read complete instructions carefully

* Pay attention to context, details, and deadlines

* Are genuinely skilled, not simply willing to try

* Can provide evidence of previous work and results

* Communicate clearly, directly, and confidently in English

* Ask thoughtful questions when information is missing or unclear

* Are comfortable communicating through written messages, meetings, video, and voice notes

* Can give, receive, and implement constructive feedback

* Think critically rather than automatically agreeing

* Can respectfully challenge an idea and explain their reasoning

* Notice problems and propose practical solutions

* Exercise independent professional judgment

* Take ownership of their work, decisions, and mistakes

* Meet deadlines and arrive prepared and on time

* Communicate early when a genuine emergency affects a commitment

* Can distinguish between an unavoidable emergency and a competing personal priority

* Work independently without disappearing, silently guessing, or requiring constant supervision

* Care about quality, client experience, revenue, and measurable business results

* Are emotionally intelligent, mature, dependable, discreet, and professional

* Can communicate professionally with senior leaders, clients, partners, sponsors, affiliates, venues, speakers, and other organizations

* Want to contribute to a strong team rather than complete disconnected tasks mechanically



We do not want “yes people.”



If you see a problem, risk, inconsistency, or better way to accomplish something, we expect you to raise it respectfully. We value informed professional opinions, sound reasoning, and people who can explain why they recommend a particular approach.



Discussion must lead to action. Strong communication is not a substitute for completing excellent work.



FEMINIST VALUES, ETHICAL JUDGMENT, AND BDS



Every team member must remain aware of the company’s ethical commitments and apply them consistently.



Décalage Solutions supports Palestinian liberation and takes the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement seriously.



Team members must not select or recommend companies, platforms, products, speakers, venues, sponsors, affiliates, partners, media outlets, suppliers, or service providers without considering who owns them, what they support, and whether working with them is consistent with our values.



This responsibility applies to every role.



Team members may be expected to:



* Research company ownership, parent companies, investors, partnerships, and corporate conduct

* Check companies and products for known BDS targets and other ethical concerns

* Consider anti-racist, anti-colonial, feminist, LGBTQ+ inclusive, disability, labour, environmental, and human-rights implications

* Identify potential conflicts before presenting a recommendation

* Explain the evidence and reasoning behind an assessment

* Recommend ethical alternatives when an option is not aligned

* Continue monitoring relevant information rather than assuming that a company’s status will never change



If you do not know whether something is aligned, you are expected to investigate and ask.



You must never assume that an option is acceptable simply because it is popular, convenient, profitable, or used by other companies.



Applicants will be tested on their understanding of our values and on how they would apply those values within their specific area of work.



Repeating definitions or copying our language will not demonstrate alignment. Applicants must be able to evaluate unfamiliar situations, identify ethical concerns, conduct appropriate research, and make reasoned recommendations.



QUALITY CONTROL AND DEFINITION OF COMPLETION



Work must not be represented as complete until it has been reviewed and tested.



Depending on the responsibility, quality control may include:



* Checking every link and button

* Testing forms, payment processes,
 sequences, automations, and scheduling systems

* Reviewing work on desktop and mobile devices

* Confirming that the complete client or customer journey functions as intended

* Checking names, dates, prices, spelling, formatting, permissions, and access

* Verifying that claims, research, and recommendations are accurate

* Confirming BDS and broader ethical alignment

* Ensuring that the work meets the complete original brief

* Reporting anything that remains incomplete, uncertain, or untested



“Complete” means that the work has been finished, checked, and shown to function.



It does not mean that something has merely been drafted, uploaded, scheduled, or assumed to work.



Team members must communicate progress without waiting to be chased. If a deadline, deliverable, or result is at risk, we expect early communication together with a proposed solution.



PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY



Life happens, and genuine emergencies occur. Professional accountability means communicating promptly, taking responsibility, and helping protect the work when circumstances change.



Repeated lateness, last-minute notice about foreseeable conflicts, missed instructions, unexplained absences, unfinished work, or excuses in place of accountability will not be compatible with this team.



If you commit to a meeting, deadline, or agreed working period, we expect you to organize your other responsibilities accordingly.



Mistakes can be discussed and corrected. Dishonesty, repeated carelessness, misrepresentation of ability, and refusal to take responsibility cannot.



We are interested in what you can reliably contribute, not promises unsupported by evidence.



AI USE



We use AI in our work. Applicants may use AI tools to help organize, edit, or refine their applications and work.



Using AI is not a problem.



Using AI to misrepresent your experience, judgment, communication ability, knowledge, or technical competence is a problem.



We assume that some applicants will place this posting into an AI tool and generate polished answers. A polished application will not be treated as evidence that you can perform the work.



You must be able to explain and defend everything submitted under your name. You may be asked detailed follow-up questions about any answer, claim, recommendation, or work sample.



Shortlisted applicants will be tested through live discussion, unfamiliar scenarios, verification of previous work, and a paid practical assessment.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit a concise, personalized application that answers every question below.



1. Which specific area or areas listed in this posting are you applying for?



2. What are your three strongest professional skills?



3. Which responsibilities can you perform independently at a professional level?



4. Which responsibility listed here should we not hire you to perform, and why?



5. Describe one project for which you took meaningful ownership. What were you responsible for, what problem arose, and what result did you produce?



6. Describe a time you disagreed with a client or supervisor. How did you communicate your concern, and what happened?



7. Describe a professional mistake you made. How did you address it?



8. What does intersectional feminism mean to you, and how has it influenced a decision you have made?



9. What is your understanding of the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement?



10. Imagine that a potentially profitable sponsor, affiliate, platform, or business partner has a connection to a BDS target or a record of human-rights violations. Explain exactly what you would do before making a recommendation.



11. What would you do if you noticed that company content, a potential partner, or another team member’s recommendation conflicted with the stated values of Décalage Solutions?



12. How could your specific area of work contribute to both our mission and the financial success of the company?



13. What working hours can you reliably commit to? Include your time zone, availability, internet reliability, and current work commitments.



14. What is your expected hourly rate?



15. Provide links to relevant work samples, case studies, or a portfolio. Explain what part of each example you personally completed.



16. Include a link to a short video or voice introduction of no more than two minutes. Tell us why you are interested in Décalage Solutions and what you could contribute.



Begin your application with this sentence:



“I read the complete posting. I am applying in the area of __________.”



Generic, copied, mass-produced, or incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Statements that you are hardworking, passionate, loyal, dedicated, or willing to learn are not evidence of competence. Show us how you think, communicate, solve problems, and produce results.



SELECTION PROCESS



Our selection process is rigorous because we are looking for demonstrated ability, judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment.



Depending on the role, the process may include:



* Review of the complete written application

* Verification of previous work and results

* A short exploration meeting

* Detailed follow-up questions

* Live values and judgment scenarios

* A small, time-limited paid practical assessment

* Reference verification

* A clearly defined paid trial period

* Written expectations, deadlines, and performance measures



Before beginning a paid assessment, the applicant will receive the following information in writing:



* The task

* The expected deliverable

* The maximum authorized time

* The payment

* The deadline

* The evaluation criteria



Completing an assessment does not guarantee ongoing work.



Applicants may be evaluated on:



* Role-specific technical skill

* Accuracy and attention to detail

* Quality of judgment

* Emotional intelligence

* Ability to follow the complete brief

* Ability to identify missing information

* Clear and timely communication

* Appropriate use of AI and other tools

* Ability to explain decisions

* Application of feminist and ethical values

* Understanding and application of BDS

* Ability to receive and implement feedback

* Reliability and respect for deadlines

* Honest representation of competence

* Overall quality of completed work



Only agreed tasks and authorized time will be paid. Applicants must not exceed the stated time limit, expand the assignment, or perform additional work without written approval.



PAID TRIAL PERIOD AND CONTINUED WORK



Applicants who successfully complete the selection process may be offered a limited paid trial period for a specific role.



Each trial period will have clearly defined:



* Responsibilities

* Authorized working hours

* Deliverables

* Deadlines

* Communication expectations

* Performance standards

* Evaluation dates



Continued work depends on meeting the written standards established for the role.



Décalage Solutions may end a trial or working relationship if a team member:



* Cannot demonstrate the skills represented in their application

* Misrepresents experience, availability, competence, working time, or completed work

* Repeatedly misses or misunderstands clear instructions

* Produces work below the agreed standard

* Fails to meet agreed deadlines

* Does not communicate promptly about problems

* Requires substantially more supervision than the role permits

* Does not receive or implement feedback

* Is repeatedly unavailable during agreed working periods

* Records unauthorized hours or performs unauthorized work

* Does not meet the role’s written performance measures

* Disregards the company’s feminist, political, BDS, or ethical commitments



All authorized work completed up to the end of the arrangement will be paid. Ending the arrangement means that no additional work or hours will be assigned.



Please apply only if you are comfortable having your stated skills, professional judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment tested.



We are building a company with ambitious goals, substantive values, and high professional standards.



We want people who are proud to contribute to work that matters, who care whether the business succeeds, and who possess the professional discipline to help make that success possible.

* Assisting with or preparing U.S. business tax returns, including:

    * S Corporations – Form 1120-S

* Year-end bookkeeping cleanup and preparation for tax returns

* Maintaining organized and accurate client financial records

* Communicating questions or discrepancies that require further review



Qualifications:



* Hands-on experience preparing U.S. individual and business income tax returns

* Strong understanding of Form 1040 and common individual tax schedules

Strong Plus:

Accuracy, confidentiality, dependability, and the ability to recognize when something does not look correct are extremely important for this position.

title: Data & Reporting Specialist – Shopify Dropshipping (Detail-Oriented, Proactive)
description:
Dear applicant,



We run a growing Shopify dropshipping operation and are scaling hard this year. We are looking for a Data & Reporting Specialist to join a new team.



This is **not** a copy-paste data entry role. You will be the person who checks whether our numbers are correct, notices when something looks wrong, and tells us before it becomes a problem. If a number in the sheet doesn't make sense, we expect you to flag it — not to enter it and move on.



You must be able to think for yourself and communicate clearly. To show you read this post carefully, start your reply with the word **strawberry** before you introduce yourself.



**Please answer these questions in your application:**



1. Which of these have you worked with, and for how long: Shopify,
 Ads Manager, Slack, Incogniton, Google Sheets?

2. Describe a time you spotted an error in data someone else produced. What did you do?

3. In a Google Sheet with daily ad spend and revenue per product, which numbers would you check first to see if something is off? Why?

4. What do you do when the workflow tells you one thing, but the data clearly says something else?

5. Are you available 4–10 hours a day, 7 days a week? Which hours (state your timezone)?

6. What internet speed and backup connection do you have?



**Requirements:**



- Experience with
 Ads Manager (must)

- Experience with Shopify (must)

- Strong written English and proactive communication (must)

- Comfortable following written workflows and video training (must)

- Confident in Google Sheets — filtering, cross-checking, spotting inconsistencies

- Able to read data and explain what it means, not just record it

- Experience with Slack

- Experience with Incogniton is a plus



If you do not meet these requirements, please do not apply — thank you.



**Your responsibilities:**



- Recording daily KPIs accurately and on time

- **Verifying** the data: cross-checking numbers, catching mistakes, missing entries and outliers

- **Reporting proactively**: a short daily update on what you saw, what changed, and anything that looks wrong

- Raising delays or blockers immediately instead of waiting to be asked

- Coordinating with team members in the same process

- Working according to our strategy, workflows and schedule



We provide full workflows and video training for every step of the process. We offer real career growth for team members who take ownership.



If this sounds like you, apply with your answers to the questions above.



Best regards,



TWK

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview



NOTE: Previous applicant need NOT TO APPLY.

title: Experienced Podcast Video Editor Needed
description:
I'm launching a long-form video podcast and looking for an experienced podcast editor to take on the full

season. This is a well-defined package with a clear scope, and I'm looking for someone who can own the

editing end-to-end and deliver a polished, consistent look across every episode and clip.

If this goes well, there's a strong chance of ongoing work on future seasons.



Scope of Work

1. Long-form episodes — 11 total

• Full edit of each episode (raw multi-cam footage, approx. [45–90] minutes per episode)

• Multi-cam switching, cutting dead air, ums/ahs, and tangents

• Color correction and audio cleanup/leveling

• Lower thirds, name titles, intro/outro, and on-screen text where appropriate

• B-roll, graphics, or captions inserted where they add value

• Final export optimized for YouTube (and audio-only version for Spotify/Apple if needed)



2. Short-form clips — 110 total (10 per episode)

• Identify the most engaging, shareable moments from each episode

• Edit into vertical 9:16 clips (30–90 seconds) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Animated captions/subtitles, punch-ins, zooms, hooks, and progress bars in the style of the references below



3. Short-form trailers — 11 total (1 per episode)

• 30–60 second vertical trailer teasing each episode

• Fast-paced, hook-driven, designed to drive viewers to the full episode



Editing Style / References
