title: 🔥 HIRING: Performance Video Editor + AI Creative Specialist
description:
Help us build one of the leading kids health brands in Europe.



Remote · Full-Time · Strong Base + Uncapped Performance Bonuses



We’re not looking for someone who just wants another video editing job.



We’re looking for one person who wants to become world-class at performance creative - and wants their income to grow with their performance.



Wunderwell is a fast-growing German DTC brand building health products specifically for children.



But we’re not here to build another supplement company.



Our goal is to build the brand parents think of when it comes to supporting their children through the different stages and moments of growing up.



And creative is going to be one of the biggest reasons we get there.



That’s where you come in.



This is NOT a normal editing role.



We don't need someone who can make videos look pretty.



We need someone who understands why people buy.



You should care about:



Hooks.

Retention.

Pacing.

Emotional triggers.

Buyer psychology.

Direct response.

UGC.

Storytelling.

AI.

And ultimately: sales.



Your creatives won't disappear into some client folder.



They go live. They get real ad spend. We see exactly what happens.



If they lose, we learn.

If they win, we scale them.



And when your creatives win, you win financially too.



That feedback loop will allow you to become a much better marketer than someone who spends years editing videos without ever knowing whether they actually sold anything.



What you'll actually do



You'll work closely with one of our Founders and turn ideas, scripts and raw footage into ads that sell.



You do not need to speak German. We provide the German scripts, copy and strategic direction. Your job is to turn them into creatives that perform.



This is also not just a cut-and-caption job. A major part of this role is creating content yourself with AI - and then turning it into finished performance ads.



That includes:



- Cutting raw footage from our real UGC creators into high-converting Meta ads

- Finding and layering the right B-roll to strengthen every line of the script

- Creating strong hooks and maintaining attention throughout the video

- Understanding the marketing idea behind a brief instead of blindly executing it

- Studying our winning ads and understanding why they worked

- Iterating winners quickly with new hooks, openings, B-roll and structures

- Using AI to create footage we couldn't produce traditionally

- Creating AI B-roll and AI-generated scenes

- Creating realistic AI talking heads / avatars

- Creating AI animations and visualizations

- Using AI voiceovers and other AI-native creative formats

- Constantly testing new tools and workflows that make our creatives better or faster

- Looking at performance feedback and applying those learnings to your next edit



We already have creators producing real footage.



Your job is to turn those raw ingredients into something people stop scrolling for and eventually buy from.



We want someone OBSESSED with getting better.



You don't need to know every AI tool on day one.



But you do need to already be an excellent editor and you need to learn insanely fast.



You should be the type of person who sees a great ad and immediately wonders:



"Why does this work?"



Someone who saves winning ads.



Studies competitors.



Experiments with new AI tools before being asked.



Tries a different opening because you think it could perform better.



And actually shares ideas with the team.



We don't want someone waiting all day for the next task.



If you see an opportunity, say it.



If you think our brief could be better, tell us.



If you discover a new AI workflow that could change how we produce creatives, show us.



You start as an editor.



But editing does not have to be your ceiling.



The path



Performance Video Editor → Senior Editor → Creative Strategist → Creative Lead



How quickly you move through that path is largely up to you.



We want to teach you how we think about:



 Direct response marketing.

 Customer research.

 Hooks & angles.

 Copywriting.

 Creative strategy.

 Meta advertising.

 AI creative production.

 Performance analysis.



Our goal isn't to have you pushing buttons for us for the next three years.



Our goal is to make you dangerous.



Someone who can eventually look at an audience, understand what makes them buy, develop an angle, build the creative and analyze whether it worked.



And we reward performance.



There will be a competitive monthly base salary depending on your skill and experience.



But that's only the starting point.



On top of your base, you'll earn performance bonuses for winning creatives.



We want incentives aligned:



When Wunderwell grows because of your work, you should participate in that upside.



The better you become →

 the better your creatives perform →

 the more responsibility you earn →

 the more money you can make.



We're not interested in artificially capping an A-player.



If you become extremely valuable to Wunderwell, we want this to become an extremely valuable position for you.



We would rather overpay one great editor than underpay three average ones.



Who we're looking for



You probably fit if:



- You already have a strong video editing portfolio

- You've edited direct-response / DTC / e-commerce ads before

- You understand that an ad's job is to sell, not win a design award

- You're extremely comfortable with modern AI tools

- You can create convincing AI video, B-roll, talking heads and animations

- You're fast without becoming sloppy

- You're reliable and communicate quickly

- You take direct feedback without ego

- You're curious about marketing beyond editing

- You take ownership instead of waiting to be managed

- You genuinely want to become exceptional at what you do



Experience in supplements, health, wellness or parenting is a plus - but hunger and ability matter more.



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You want a comfortable 9–5 where you finish your assigned edits and collect your paycheck.

- You need someone to constantly tell you what to do.

- You disappear when things get busy.

- You take direct feedback personally.

- You need three days for an edit that should take a few hours.

- You care more about cinematic transitions than conversion.

- You aren't interested in AI.

- You aren't interested in understanding the numbers behind your creatives.

- Or you're looking to do the minimum required.



There are easier jobs.

This isn't one of them.



Why Wunderwell?



Because you're joining early enough that your work can actually matter.



We're ambitious.

We're building quickly.

We're constantly testing.



And we want people around us who see that as an opportunity rather than pressure.



You'll work closely with the people making the decisions.

You'll see what happens to the creatives you make.

You'll learn from real performance data.

You'll get access to the tools you need.

You'll be encouraged to experiment with AI.

You'll have room to take ownership far beyond editing.



And if you become one of the people who helps us turn Wunderwell into a major European brand, we want you to grow with it.



We're not looking for someone to fill an editing seat.



We're looking for someone who wants to earn their seat at the table.



How to apply



We're intentionally making the hiring process difficult.



Portfolio → Short Interview → Paid Test Edit → Final Call



We care much more about what you can actually do than what your CV says.



One important thing: Start your application with I'M ALL IN FOR WUNDERWELL so we know you actually read the entire post. 



Applications without it will NOT be considered.



When applying, send us:



1. Your 3 best performance ads



Not your prettiest videos.

Show us ads you believe actually sell.



2. Your best AI creative



Show us what you can do with modern AI video tools.



3. One ad you personally think is brilliant



It doesn't need to be yours.

Tell us in 3–5 sentences why you think it works.



4. Tell us which AI tools you currently use



For video, images, avatars, voice and audio.



5. How quickly can you deliver the first draft of a 30-second ad once you receive the brief and assets?



6. Your current monthly compensation expectation



7. And answer this question:



Why do you want to become one of the best performance creatives in DTC?



If your answer is basically "I need a remote job" - this probably isn't the right role.



But if you want to spend the next few years becoming ridiculously good at performance marketing, work with people who expect a lot from you, get rewarded when your work wins, and help build something from an early stage:



We want to hear from you!

title: Creator Sourcing & Outreach VA
description:
Real Mad Honey is a premium DTC brand selling wild Himalayan mad honey, sourced by hand at 3,500+ 

meters and third-party tested for purity. We've served 50,000+ customers and we're growing fast.



We're hiring a VA who will report directly to the Creator Partnerships Manager — owning creator sourcing, 

outreach, and keeping our whole partnerships operation organized and easy to navigate. This is a hands-on 

assisting role, not just task execution: you'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Finding Creators

• Look online for creators who make content we could work with.

• Check if each one is really a good fit for our brand — not just how many followers they have.

• Write down why each one is a good pick, so a decision can be made fast.

• Be the first point of contact, and inform the manager on rates for negotiation.



Organizing Our Files & Content

• Keep our files and folders neat, so anyone on the team can find what they need in seconds.

• When videos or photos come in from a creator, save, label, and keep track of them the right way — so 

nothing gets lost, and no one has to dig through a mess to find a clip later.

• Keep a simple, up-to-date list of every deal: who it's with, what stage it's at, when it's due, and whether 

it's paid.

• Make sure product gets shipped and creators get their tracking info.



Helping the Manager

• Tell the manager right away if a creator is doing great work — they might be worth a bigger deal.

• Tell the manager right away if something's going wrong. Don't wait and hope it fixes itself.

• Help build our creator community across our programs — seeding, ambassadors, and more.

• Help with other small tasks as they come up. This role grows as you do.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

• You know the kind of creators and personas that fit our brand.

• You've sourced your first few creators.

• You understand our budget and know how to lock in a deal — rate, contract, all of it.

• You know how our database works and how we keep it clean and organized.

• You understand the different creator programs we run, the tools we use to source, and how our whole 

system fits together.



First 60 Days

• You're finding and vetting creators without needing much guidance.

• Our files and content are organized well enough that someone else could jump in and understand 

everything.

• You're catching problems early and flagging them before they get bigger.

• You're starting to spot creators who could grow into bigger roles — ambassadors, repeat collaborators — 

and flagging them to the manager.



First 120 Days

• You're running the sourcing and organizing side of this role on your own.

• The manager trusts your picks and your organization without double-checking.

• You're already suggesting ways to make the process better.

• You're helping the manager grow our creator community across all our programs — seeding, 

ambassadors, Trybe, and beyond.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience with UGC sourcing or creator management, ideally in a DTC or e-commerce 

context.

• Comfortable finding and vetting talent across sourcing platforms.

• Experience supporting paid ads teams and understanding how UGC feeds into performance creative.

• Strong eye for creator quality — you can tell who fits the brand and who'll actually perform, before you 

ever send an outreach message.

• Excellent written English for outreach, negotiations, and creator briefs.

• Organized across multiple timelines, multiple creators, and multiple campaigns simultaneously.

• Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers and general workspace tools.



MUST HAVES

• Straight to the point communicator. No long, confusing instructions needed either direction.

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told.

• Integrity. We're remote and run on trust.

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing your own time without needing constant check-ins.

• This must be your only job. Full commitment, full presence.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Someone organized enough that a manager can hand off a messy pile of creator info and trust it comes back 

usable — clear, honest, and dependable.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us your resume (CV) and a short intro video telling us about yourself and your motivation — we want to 

see your energy and how you communicate, not just read about it.

If you're shortlisted, we'll send you the test assignment as the next step.



Start your application with the words “Honey Hive” so we know you actually read this whole posting.

We read everything. 



Real applications only — copy-paste responses will be ignored.

title: Client Ops Associate
description:
Client Ops Associate (Path to Key Account Manager)

Full Time | Remote | Reports to Head of Ops/Delivery



About the company

CivSav is a digital marketing agency built specifically for agriculture and heavy machinery companies across the USA. We run SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, and
/lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo) for a growing roster of ag clients. We're a lean, fast-moving team — not a big-agency bureaucracy — and we're scaling from a strong client base toward 100+ accounts without losing the quality that got us here.



About the role

We're hiring a Client Ops Associate to be the operational backbone of our client relationships. This is not a call-center support role and it's not a senior strategist role — it's the seat where someone proves they can be trusted with a client relationship, and grows from there.



You'll start by making sure nothing falls through the cracks: onboarding new clients, keeping tabs on what's been delivered versus what's been promised, and handling the day-to-day questions clients have. If you're good at this — organized, calm under pressure, and someone clients trust — this role is the direct path to owning a full book of clients as a Key Account Manager.



We are deliberately hiring this as an assistant-level role with a real growth path, not a dead-end support job. The person we hire in twelve months should look nothing like the person we hire today.



What success looks like

- New clients are onboarded smoothly: accounts and access collected without chasing, kickoff calls run on time, nothing missed.

- Clients get fast, clear answers to routine questions, and you know exactly when something needs to go to a specialist or to leadership instead of you handling it yourself.

- Nothing executed for a client goes untracked. If someone asks "where are we on X client," you have the answer in under a minute.

- You build a track record of good judgment — knowing what you can decide on your own and what needs a second opinion — that earns you more client ownership over time.



Key responsibilities



Customer support

- First point of contact for routine client questions and requests.

- Follow a clear escalation path: technical issues to the relevant specialist, anything involving expectations, money, or a frustrated client to your manager.

- Keep client communication professional, timely, and honest — we do not overpromise to make a moment easier.



Onboarding

- Run new clients through our onboarding process: collecting domain, ad account,Klaviyo, and analytics access.Onboarding clients on meta and GHL.

- Schedule and run kickoff calls using our onboarding playbook.

- Make sure every new client is fully set up and hands off cleanly to the delivery team.



Project management assistance

- Track what's been executed for each client across SEO, ads,
, and web — using our shared tracking system.

- Flag work that's stalled or at risk before it becomes a client complaint.

- Keep a clear, current record any manager can check without needing to ask you directly.



Growth path

- Months 0–3: support, onboarding, and tracking, fully trained on our systems, all client-facing work reviewed before it goes out.

- Months 3–6: independently own a small group of standard-tier clients — ongoing check-ins, reporting, routine decisions — with regular check-ins with your manager.

- Months 6–12+: full ownership of an assigned client roster as a Key Account Manager, with review shifting to spot-checks and true escalations only.



Progression is based on demonstrated judgment and reliability, not just time served.



About you — required

- Excellent written and verbal English communication.

- Highly organized — you naturally track details without being told twice.

- Comfortable talking to clients directly, including when a conversation is a little uncomfortable.

- Genuinely ambitious about growing into a client-ownership role, not just looking for a support job.

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace for client calls, and availability during US business hours.



About you — preferred

- Prior experience in an agency, customer success, or account coordination role.

- Familiarity with basic digital marketing concepts (you don't need to run SEO or ads, but you should be able to follow a conversation about them).

- Familiarity with GHL, Meta Business Suite

- Experience with a task-tracking tool (ClickUp, Jira, spreadsheets, or similar).







How to apply

We read every application carefully, and we pay close attention to how instructions are followed — it tells us a lot before we ever get on a call.



Subject line: "Hi, I'm YOUR NAME from CITY/COUNTRY and I'm applying for the Client Ops Associate role."



In the body of your
, include:

1. A two-sentence opening: your name, where you're from, and that you're applying.

2. Three sentences on the most relevant experience you have for this specific role.

3. Three sentences on a time you had to stay organized while juggling multiple people's expectations at once — what happened, and how you kept it from falling apart.

4. Three sentences on where you want to be in two years, and why this role is a step toward that.

5. A closing line with your name,
, and phone number.



Attach your current resume or CV.



Candidates who follow these instructions completely move to the next stage, which includes a short scenario exercise designed to show us how you think under a bit of pressure — not to trick you, but to make sure we're both confident before we ever put you in a room with a client.

title: InDesign Automation Wizard (Scripts/JSX) – Massive 3-Year Project (PH Only)
description:
Job Description:

We are a fast-growing publishing house rolling out thousands of 4-page Cramcharts (
) and quick reference guides over the next 3 years. We are looking for a handful of technical layout specialists who live and breathe Adobe InDesign automation.



Important: I do not need a pure "artist." I need a technician who can design. If you are a creative genius but manually place text boxes one by one, we are not a fit. If you are passably creative but can import a messy Word document, run a GREP script, map styles in 3 seconds, and automate a 4-page spread via Data Merge or JSX—you are our ideal candidate.



What you will do:



Receive raw Word manuscripts and seamlessly roll them into InDesign using style mapping, GREP, and scripts.



Build and maintain master templates for 4-page quick-reference folders.



Use JavaScript/ExtendScript (or even custom plugins) to shave hours off repetitive layout tasks.



Provide quality control on imported text (orphans, widows, consistent leading).



Work alongside a team of other automation designers to handle the volume.



Who you are:



Technical proficiency is non-negotiable. You know how to write or modify scripts to speed up workflows.



Excellent English (written & spoken). I need to jump on a voice call and understand you immediately, and you need to understand me without me repeating instructions. Accents are fine; unclear communication and limited English is not.



Proactive & positive. You see a bottleneck and figure out how to script your way around it. Lazy people who wait for instructions will be filtered out quickly.



Hungry to grow. We prefer early/mid-career designers who are adaptable and eager to learn modern efficiency, over senior designers set in their old manual ways.



Compensation & Commitment:



I cannot pay North American rates, but I pay competitive Philippine rates for the right talent.



Payment structure: I prefer flat-rate per completed title (so you earn more the faster and more efficiently you work). However, I am open to hourly for an absolute rockstar. We will discuss what works best for you.

title: Remote Medical Office Manager
description:
We are a thriving acupuncture practice with clinics in Santa Cruz, California, with a culture that's positive, compassionate, and committed to patient satisfaction. Our founders built this business from the ground up and have worked every position in the company themselves. We're hiring a fully remote Medical Office Manager, based in the Philippines, to oversee our insurance biller and keep billing, reception, and patient coordination running smoothly.



Position Overview



This role manages our insurance biller and works closely with our front desk team to keep every patient's insurance, billing, and scheduling on track. You'll be the connective link between our biller, reception, and patients — anticipating issues and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Schedule

20–25 hours per week.

Required availability that overlaps with our Pacific Time (California) business hours, so you can coordinate in real time with reception, the insurance biller, and patients.

Includes a remote reception shift every Saturday (8-hour day), covering phone lines, scheduling, and patient support.



Roles and Responsibilities

Oversee insurance billing: work with our biller on claims, payments, denials, and workers' comp, and monitor aging reports and collections.

Act as the liaison between the biller, reception, and patients on billing, claim status, and coverage questions.

Run benefit checks, evaluate coverage, and call potential new patients about their insurance benefits to get them scheduled.

Manage new patient referrals and authorizations (Kaiser, physicians, workers' comp), keeping visit counts and renewals current.

Manage day-to-day operations and oversee all office and administrative responsibilities to ensure a smooth flow.

Assist with business planning and the improvement of administrative processes; design, develop, and integrate new office infrastructure that supports our standard of care and patient satisfaction.

title: Content & Digital Marketing Assistant – Running / Endurance Sports
description:
I am launching a running coaching business focused on helping serious recreational runners improve their performance. The business will initially offer personalized 1-on-1 coaching and may later expand into a paid online running community.



I am looking for a smart, creative, highly reliable person to help me build and operate the digital side of the business.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant role. I am looking for someone who can take raw ideas, videos, photos, voice notes, and coaching concepts and turn them into polished, professional content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Manage and help grow the business's Instagram presence

• Edit short-form running videos and Reels

• Create clean, professional graphics and carousel posts

• Write strong captions and other content based on source material I provide

• Help build and maintain a simple, professional coaching website

• Maintain a content calendar and schedule posts

• Repurpose individual pieces of source material into multiple pieces of content

• Help establish and maintain a consistent visual brand and writing style

• Use AI tools intelligently to make the content-development process faster and better

• Eventually assist with
/newsletter marketing and the digital/administrative side of a paid running community



HOW WE'LL WORK



I will provide the expertise and source material: raw videos, voice notes, photos, training observations, ideas, and conversations about running and coaching.



Your job is to turn that raw material into finished content.



For example, I might send you a 5-minute video explaining a marathon-training concept. A great person in this role might see opportunities to turn that single video into a Reel, carousel, written post, website article, and several future content ideas.



I do NOT want generic AI-generated fitness content. The coaching philosophy and technical running advice will come from me. I want you to help me communicate those ideas exceptionally well.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should be strong in most of the following:



• Excellent written English

• Instagram content creation

• Short-form video editing (CapCut or similar)

• Canva

• ChatGPT and/or other AI tools

• Content repurposing

• Squarespace, WordPress, or similar website platforms

• Strong visual/design judgment

• Excellent organization and reliability

• Ability to work independently and take initiative



BONUS: RUNNING / ENDURANCE SPORTS



A genuine interest in running, marathon training, endurance sports, fitness, or sports science would be a major advantage.



You do NOT need to be a running coach. But if you're a runner yourself—or genuinely interested in endurance sports—please tell me about it.



This is approximately 10 hours per week initially, with a flexible schedule. There is an opportunity for the role to grow as the coaching business grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send me a generic application. I care much more about your work, creativity, and how you think than I do about a long résumé.



Please include:



A brief introduction and why THIS particular role interests you.

Tell me whether you personally have any interest or experience in running, endurance sports, fitness, or sports science.

Links to 2–3 examples of your BEST work. These can include Instagram content, short-form video, graphics, websites, or other digital content. Tell me specifically what YOU created or were responsible for.

Briefly describe your experience with Instagram, Canva, video editing/CapCut, ChatGPT or other AI tools, and website platforms such as Squarespace or WordPress.

Imagine I send you a 5-minute video of me explaining a running-training concept. What would you do with it? Briefly tell me the different pieces of content you could create from that one video.

Tell me your current availability and preferred working hours.

Tell me your desired hourly rate in USD.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words "RUN TALL."



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



I am looking for someone who could become a long-term partner in building this business. Initially I will review content before publication. Over time, my goal is to work with someone who understands my voice, standards, and coaching philosophy well enough to operate with substantial independence.

title: **HIRING: Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator – Insurance Relocation**
description:
ReloCovered is a U.S.-based temporary housing company that helps families find furnished housing when they are displaced from their homes due to fire, water damage, insurance claims, renovations, and other covered losses.



We are looking for an **experienced Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator** who understands the insurance relocation and corporate housing industry.



**This position is specifically for candidates with temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance relocation, ALE, leasing, or similar housing-placement experience.**



### Responsibilities



* Manage temporary housing requests from initial intake through completed placement

* Review each family's housing requirements, location, budget, move-in date, pets, bedrooms, school needs, and other requirements

* Source appropriate furnished and unfurnished properties

* Contact landlords, property managers, real estate agents, and property owners

* Verify availability and property details

* Negotiate rental rates, deposits, lease terms, utilities, furnishings, and extensions

* Present housing options for approval

* Communicate with insurance relocation companies, adjusters, policyholders, landlords, and agents

* Follow up consistently until the housing placement is approved and secured

* Coordinate rental applications and screening through approved secure systems

* Prepare and coordinate lease documentation

* Coordinate move-in details

* Manage lease extensions when additional temporary housing is required

* Maintain accurate notes and status updates for every housing case

* Protect confidential company pricing, negotiated rates, client information, and business margins

* Work closely with ReloCovered management to successfully complete placements



### Experience We Are Looking For



**Strong preference will be given to applicants who have previously worked for:**



* Temporary housing companies

* Insurance relocation companies

* Corporate housing companies

* ALE / Additional Living Expense housing providers

* Property insurance claims organizations

* Furnished housing companies

* Relocation companies

* Mid-term rental companies



Experience working with insurance adjusters, displaced policyholders, landlords, real estate agents, and property managers is highly preferred.



Existing experience or relationships within the **insurance temporary-housing industry** is a major advantage.



### You Should Be Able To:



* Understand how an insurance temporary-housing placement works from beginning to end

* Speak confidently with U.S. landlords, agents, adjusters, and clients

* Negotiate rental terms professionally

* Search quickly for properties that meet specific housing requirements

* Manage multiple active housing placements simultaneously

* Follow up aggressively and professionally

* Keep every case organized and documented

* Work independently and solve problems

* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing and client information



### Ideal Candidate



We are especially interested in someone who has **already worked inside the temporary housing / insurance relocation industry** and can bring real-world knowledge of how placements are handled.



We do not want to train someone from zero on what temporary housing is.



We want someone who understands the industry and can help ReloCovered grow its housing-placement operation.



### Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience.



**Performance and placement bonuses available for successfully completed housing placements.**



### HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. Your resume

2. A short voice introduction

3. The names or types of temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance, relocation, or property companies you have worked for

4. How many years of temporary-housing or relocation experience you have

5. Describe your role in completing a housing placement from the initial request through move-in

6. Tell us whether you have experience communicating with insurance adjusters or ALE/relocation companies

7. Tell us whether you have existing industry relationships

8. Your expected compensation



**Please apply only if you have relevant housing, relocation, corporate housing, leasing, or insurance-industry experience.**

title: Graphic Designer (Apparel) + Shopify Store Assistant
description:
Probation of 1 to 3 months at $500/month base, then a raise based on performance. Hours: 40 hrs/week, with some flexibility on your schedule



About us

XMartial is a combat sports apparel brand (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, Muay Thai). We have served over 100,000 customers in 50+ countries with distinctive designs and high-quality gear. We move fast, we ship often, and our designs are the reason people buy from us instead of everyone else.



What this role is

You design our apparel. Rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees: you create the vector artwork, build the print files, and produce the mockups that go live on the store and into our ads.



Design is the core of the job and where most of your week goes. The rest of your time you work as a general store assistant, supporting whatever the store needs that week: uploading and organizing products in Shopify, resizing and preparing images, editing banners, fixing catalog issues, and other hands-on tasks.



This is an independent role. We give you the brief, the references, and the print specs, and trust you to deliver finished, production-ready work without being chased.



What you will do

Apparel design (the main job) + Shopify Store Assistant



Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees.

Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes.

Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent.

Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell.



Mockups and visuals

Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social.

Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium.

Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics.



General store assistant work

Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings.

Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels.

Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date.



What we are looking for

Must have

Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it.

Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment.

Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching.

A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions.

A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture.

Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter.

Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role.

Good written English and reliable communication.



Nice to have

You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport.

Shopify experience.

Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster.

Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers.



How we work

Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize.



How to apply

All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by
 or DM.



Apply here: 



Have your portfolio ready, with at least a few apparel or print designs in it. To show you read this far, the form asks for a keyword: it is GRIP. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

title: Part-Time Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a creative and reliable Video Editor to support us in producing elevated visual content for hotels, lifestyle brands, events, experiences, and product campaigns.

You should be equally comfortable producing fast-paced short-form content and longer, story-driven edits.



Key Responsibilities

-Turn raw footage from events, hotel properties, lifestyle shoots, product launches, and brand activations into compelling visual narratives

-Select the strongest footage and organize it into a clear, intentional story

-Edit videos in sync with music, movement, and emotional beats

-Apply professional color correction and color grading to create a polished and consistent visual style

-Incorporate sound design, music, graphics, text, transitions, and effects where appropriate

-Create multiple deliverables and platform-specific versions from a single production or campaign

-Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, references, and client feedback

-Organize project files and maintain an efficient editing and revision workflow

-Communicate progress clearly and consistently meet agreed-upon deadlines

-Work independently and confidently take an edit from raw footage to final delivery



What We’re Looking For

-Proven experience editing content for creative agencies, hospitality, lifestyle, travel, events, products, or consumer brands

-A strong portfolio featuring short-form promotional content and cinematic brand storytelling

-Experience editing event highlights, social media campaigns, advertisements, product launches, or experiential content

-Strong understanding of pacing, composition, music selection, sound design, and visual storytelling

-Advanced color-correction and color-grading skills

-Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or a comparable professional editing platform

-Ability to maintain an elevated visual style while adapting to different brands and campaign objectives

-Excellent attention to detail, file organization, and quality control

-Ability to work independently without requiring extensive direction or follow-up

-Reliable communication and consistent adherence to deadlines

-Comfortable receiving feedback and completing revisions efficiently



Nice to Have

-Experience editing hospitality, hotel, travel, food and beverage, or luxury lifestyle content

-Experience creating commercial or paid advertising content

-Knowledge of YouTube editing, formatting, and content management

-Motion graphics or animation experience

-Experience working with drone footage and footage from multiple cameras

-Understanding of codecs, frame rates, aspect ratios, audio cleanup, and export settings

-Familiarity with social media trends without relying on overly templated editing styles



How to Apply



Please send the following: 



*Your updated resume

*A link to your editing portfolio or showreel

*Three relevant samples, preferably including:

-One short-form Reel or promotional video

-One event, hospitality, travel, or lifestyle edit

-One longer-form or narrative-driven video

*The editing software you regularly use

*Your availability and typical turnaround time



Use the
 subject line: VIDEO EDITOR APPLICATION



We are especially interested in editors who can do more than assemble attractive clips. Your work should demonstrate an ability to understand a brand, identify the strongest moments, build emotion, and create videos that inspire audiences to visit, book, attend, or buy.

description:
Job type: Part time. Pay: $7 per hour plus $10 for every booked demo that shows, paid weekly. Review at four weeks with a raise to $8 for strong numbers.



About us



Snapline (
) is a small US software company. We give contractors (roofers first) a business phone line that texts back missed calls in five seconds, a Google review flow, and a website. The founder runs every demo and closes every sale. Your job is to fill his calendar.



The work



• Manual cold calls to licensed contractors in California from a list we give you. About 100 dials a day. You never buy or scrape lists.

• One goal per call: book a 15 minute demo with the founder. You do not sell, quote timelines, or explain the product beyond the script.

• Log every dial in a Google Sheet: number, outcome, notes. Keep the do-not-call list current. If someone says do not call, they are never called again.

• Short daily summary at the end of each shift: dials, conversations, bookings.



Hours



Two blocks, Monday to Friday, Pacific time: 7 to 9 in the morning and 4 to 6 in the afternoon. That is 10 pm to midnight and 7 to 9 am Manila time. Contractors answer before and after they are on the roof, so these hours are fixed. Do not apply if you cannot keep them every weekday.



You



• At least one year of outbound calling to US businesses, on the phone, not chat or
. Contractors, real estate, or home services is a plus.

• Clear, natural English. You will talk to busy tradesmen who decide in ten seconds whether to hang up.

• Comfortable with rejection. Most calls end in no. The good ones end in a booking.

• Quiet room, wired internet, a USB headset, and backup internet or power. We provide the softphone and the US number.

• Honest logging. We listen to recordings. A booking that did not happen is the end of the trial.



What we provide



The script, the objection sheet, the list, the softphone, and the founder listening to your first calls with you. A four week paid trial, then ongoing.



How to apply



Put the word ROOF as the first word of your application, then:



1. A voice recording, 60 seconds or less, reading this opener as if you were on a live call: “Hi, is this Mike? This is  with Snapline. You are on a roof and your phone rings. What happens to that call? Right. We make your phone text them back in five seconds so they do not call the next roofer, and you keep your number.”



2. Two sentences on the last US cold calling job you had and what you were booking.

 

3. Confirm you can work 10 pm to midnight and 7 to 9 am Manila time, Monday to Friday.



Applications without the word, the recording, or the confirmation are not read.

title: Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel

Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel 



**Job Type:** Freelance / Ongoing, Long-Term

**Workload:** 2 videos per week (recurring)

**Turnaround:** Fast — see details below



## About the Channel

"Permanent Jewelry, Real Talk" is a growing YouTube channel for permanent jewelry business owners — covering industry trends, business strategy, tools, and honest, no-fluff advice from a founder who's built a real studio with a team. The tone is warm, honest, and direct — like a friend leveling with you, not a polished corporate brand. We're looking for a long-term editing partner to help bring that personality to life visually.



## What You'll Be Doing

You'll receive raw, unedited sit-down talking-head footage (filmed in batches) along with any supporting photos/clips, and turn it into a polished, engaging final video — twice a week, on a consistent schedule.



## Must-Haves

- **A sharp, intriguing editing style** — you know how to take a straightforward talking-head video and make it visually engaging: pacing, cuts, zooms, text call-outs, and creative transitions that keep viewers watching, not just a static edit.

- **Fast, reliable turnaround** — you can take raw footage and deliver a finished, upload-ready video within an agreed turnaround window (please state your typical turnaround time in your application).

- **Strong command of professional editing software** (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar — no template-only tools).

- **Thumbnail design skills** — you'll also be creating custom, high-CTR thumbnails for each video (bold, clear, mobile-readable at a glance).

- **Real YouTube knowledge** — you understand what keeps modern viewers watching: strong hooks in the first few seconds, pacing that holds retention, on-screen text/captions, and current best practices for what performs on the platform (not just generic editing).

- **Consistency and communication** — reliable delivery on schedule, responsive communication, and the ability to take feedback and revise quickly.



## Nice-to-Haves

- Experience editing for business/education or personal-brand YouTube channels (not just entertainment or vlogs).

- Experience adding lower-thirds, on-screen graphics, or a consistent recurring intro/outro treatment to build a cohesive channel look.

- Comfortable syncing captions/subtitles.

- Basic motion graphics or animated text/callout skills.

- Experience repurposing long-form content into short-form clips (a plus, not required initially).



## What We'll Provide

- Raw footage, filmed and delivered in batches on a consistent schedule.

- Brand direction: tone, colors, and style guidance so every video feels consistent.

- Clear, prompt feedback on drafts.



## To Apply, Please Include:

1. Your portfolio or samples of similar talking-head/educational YouTube edits (this matters most — please don't apply without samples).

2. Your typical turnaround time per video.

3. The software you edit in.

4. Your availability for a recurring, long-term 2x/week workload.

5. Your rate per video (edit + thumbnail).



Looking for a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig — if this sounds like your kind of project, we'd love to hear from you.

title: # Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades
description:
# Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades



**Part-Time | Remote | UK Company | Approx. 2 Days per Week Initially**



We are a UK-based company supplying skilled technical personnel for projects aboard **cruise ships, superyachts, commercial vessels and within shipyards/dry docks**.



We are looking for an experienced **Technical Recruiter** to join us on a part-time, remote basis. The successful candidate will initially work approximately **2 days per week**, with the potential for the role and hours to expand for the right person.



## The Role



Your primary responsibility will be to review, screen and shortlist skilled tradespeople for marine and shipyard projects, ensuring candidates have the appropriate technical experience, qualifications and certifications before being selected for testing and potential mobilisation.



You will recruit across technical trades including:



* Welders / coded welders

* Pipefitters and fabricators

* Mechanical fitters / technicians

* Electricians

* Plumbers

* HVAC and related mechanical trades

* Other skilled marine and shipyard personnel



## Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing incoming CVs and applications

* Conducting initial candidate screening and telephone/video interviews

* Assessing candidates' technical experience and suitability for specific projects

* Reviewing welding qualifications, coding/certification and relevant trade credentials

* Understanding the difference between candidates suitable for shipyard/dry-dock work and those suitable for mobilisation aboard operational vessels

* Checking candidates' marine documentation and certification where required

* Identifying candidates who should progress to practical trade/welding testing

* Shortlisting and recommending suitable personnel to management

* Maintaining accurate candidate records and recruitment pipelines

* Communicating with candidates regarding documentation, testing, availability and potential mobilisation

* Helping develop and maintain a reliable pool of qualified technical personnel for future projects



## Technical Knowledge Required



NOTE This is **not a general recruitment or virtual assistant position**. We are specifically looking for someone who understands technical trades and can confidently assess whether a candidate's experience and qualifications are relevant.



You should have good working knowledge of several of the following areas:



**Welding & Fabrication**

Understanding of welding processes and terminology such as TIG/GTAW, MIG/MAG/GMAW, SMAW/MMA, FCAW, welding positions, materials and coded/qualified welders.



You should be comfortable reviewing welding qualifications and understanding whether a candidate's certification and experience are appropriate for the work being considered.



**Mechanical / Electrical / Plumbing**

Ability to understand CVs from mechanical fitters, pipefitters, electricians, plumbers and similar technical personnel and distinguish genuine relevant experience from general construction experience.



**Marine / Shipyard Recruitment**

Ideally, you will understand the documentation and certification that can be required when personnel work aboard vessels, cruise ships, yachts or within shipyards/dry docks.



Experience dealing with areas such as STCW certification, seafarer medicals, passports/visas, seaman's books and vessel-specific requirements would be highly advantageous.



You do not need to be a welder or engineer yourself, but you **must be technically confident enough to screen experienced tradespeople and ask the right questions**.



## Ideal Candidate



We would particularly like to hear from candidates who have previously worked in:



* Marine or maritime recruitment

* Shipyard recruitment

* Oil & gas / offshore recruitment

* Engineering recruitment

* Skilled trades recruitment

* Welding/fabrication recruitment

* Technical manpower or crewing agencies



Previous experience recruiting Filipino skilled tradespeople for international projects would be a significant advantage.



## Working Arrangement



* Fully remote position

* Working for a UK-based company

* Initially approximately **2 days per week**. Starting next month. 

* Potential to increase hours/responsibilities for the right candidate

* Some availability during UK working hours will be required

* Hourly rate: Negotiable depending on experience**



We are more interested in finding someone with the **right technical knowledge and recruitment experience** than simply selecting the lowest hourly rate.



## How to Apply



Please send your CV together with Linkedin page and a short introduction explaining your relevant recruitment experience.



In your application, please specifically answer the following:



1. What experience do you have recruiting welders, mechanical trades or other skilled technical personnel?

2. Have you recruited personnel for marine, shipyard, offshore or vessel-based work?

3. What welding qualifications/certifications are you familiar with?

4. What documentation or certification would you normally check before mobilising a tradesperson to work aboard a vessel?

5. Which technical trades are you most experienced in recruiting?

6. What hourly rate are you seeking?

7. Are you available approximately 2 days per week initially?



Applications that do not address these questions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our recruitment process and, for the right candidate, there is potential for the position to develop into a larger ongoing role.

title: Part-Time Sales & Client Outreach Assistant
description:
# Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor



**Remote | 40 Hours Per Week- $108 per week | Initial Week-to-Week Trial**



Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. is seeking a confident, reliable, organized, and results-driven **Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor** to support our outbound calling, lead generation, customer follow-up, appointment setting, and business development activities.



This is an **independent contractor engagement and not an employment position**.



The engagement will begin with a **four-week trial period conducted on a week-to-week basis**. Following successful completion of the trial period, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**, depending on performance, reliability, results, and ongoing business requirements.



---



## 1. Contract Term & Week-to-Week Trial



The first **four (4) weeks** will be considered a trial period.



During the first month:



* The engagement will operate on a **week-to-week basis**.

* Each week will be evaluated independently.

* Performance, reliability, punctuality, communication, call activity, lead follow-up, professionalism, and results will be reviewed.

* Continuation into the following week will depend on satisfactory performance and the ongoing requirements of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

* Completion of the four-week trial does not automatically guarantee a longer-term contract.



The purpose of the trial period is to determine whether the working relationship is a suitable fit for both the Contractor and Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Following successful completion of the four-week trial, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**.



There is no guarantee that the contract will continue for the full 3–6 month period. Continuation will depend on performance, results, reliability, professionalism, conduct, and business requirements.



---



## 2. Required Service Schedule



The Contractor must be available to provide services during the following agreed hours:



**Monday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Tuesday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Thursday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time



**Total: 12 hours per week**



### Strict Schedule Requirement



These service hours are a **material requirement of this contract**.



The Contractor must be logged in, available, and actively performing the agreed services beginning at **8:30 AM Pacific Time** and continuing until **12:30 PM Pacific Time** on each scheduled day.



The Contractor is expected to:



* Be ready to begin work at 8:30 AM Pacific Time.

* Remain available and actively performing contracted services until 12:30 PM Pacific Time.

* Be available for calls, follow-ups, and communication throughout the agreed service period.

* Accurately report hours and activities completed.

* Notify Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. as soon as reasonably possible in the event of an emergency.

* Request approval in advance for planned schedule changes.



The agreed hours cannot routinely be moved to evenings, other days, or different times without prior approval from Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Repeated lateness, missed service periods, unauthorized schedule changes, extended unexplained absences during agreed hours, or failure to actively perform assigned services may result in the contract not being continued or being terminated.



---



## 3. Primary Responsibilities



The Contractor's primary responsibility is to actively generate and develop sales opportunities for Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



Responsibilities include:



* Making outbound calls to prospective customers.

* Conducting cold and warm outreach.

* Contacting leads provided through Client Reach.

* Following up with new inquiries.

* Following up on outstanding estimates and sales opportunities.

* Reconnecting with previous customers and prospects.

* Contacting prospective B2B partners.

* Identifying business owners and decision-makers.

* Introducing Bloom Bug Screens products and services.

* Identifying customer needs and potential opportunities.

* Generating qualified leads.

* Booking appointments, consultations, estimates, and follow-up calls.

* Developing relationships with contractors, builders, property managers, stratas, restoration companies, designers, window companies, and other potential partners.

* Consistently following up with assigned prospects until an appropriate outcome has been established.



This is an **active outbound sales and client outreach role**.



The expectation is that the Contractor will actively make calls, contact prospects, complete follow-ups, and develop opportunities during the agreed service hours.



---



## 4. Client Reach Requirements



**Client Reach** will be the primary system used for lead management and sales activity.



All assigned customer and prospect interactions must be properly documented in Client Reach.



The Contractor will be responsible for:



* Reviewing assigned leads.

* Recording calls and contact attempts.

* Updating customer and prospect contact information.

* Adding clear and accurate notes following conversations.

* Updating lead status.

* Scheduling callbacks.

* Creating follow-up activities.

* Recording customer requirements and interests.

* Identifying hot, warm, cold, and future opportunities.

* Maintaining an organized and accurate sales pipeline.



**Every assigned customer interaction and outreach attempt must be documented in Client Reach.**



Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. must be able to review Client Reach at any time and clearly determine:



* Who was contacted.

* When they were contacted.

* Whether they answered.

* What was discussed.

* What the customer or prospect is interested in.

* Whether an estimate or appointment is required.

* What follow-up is required.

* When the next contact should take place.

* Which opportunities have the strongest potential to convert.



---



## 5. RingCentral – Business Calls & Call Recording



The Contractor will use the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. **RingCentral** system for authorized business calls.



The Contractor will be expected to:



* Use the assigned Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral account for authorized business calls.

* Make outbound calls during the agreed service hours.

* Maintain professional telephone etiquette.

* Follow approved scripts, talking points, and procedures.

* Leave professional voi
 messages when appropriate.

* Record relevant call outcomes and notes in Client Reach.

* Schedule appropriate follow-up actions.

* Maintain professional conduct whenever representing Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



### Call Recording



RingCentral includes **call-recording functionality**.



Where enabled and permitted under applicable laws and company policies, calls made or received through the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral system **may be recorded**.



Recordings may be reviewed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. for legitimate business purposes, including:



* Quality assurance.

* Training and coaching.

* Customer service.

* Verification of customer conversations.

* Sales performance.

* Follow-up verification.

* Dispute resolution.

* Compliance with company procedures.



The Contractor acknowledges that authorized business communications conducted through company systems may be recorded and reviewed.



The Contractor must comply with all instructions provided by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. concerning privacy, customer notification, consent, confidentiality, storage, and handling of recorded communications.



Business communications conducted through company-provided systems should not be considered private communications.



---



## 6. Performance Expectations



This is a **results-oriented contractor role**.



Performance will be evaluated throughout the week-to-week trial and during any subsequent contract period.



Performance may be evaluated based on:



* Punctuality and reliability.

* Adherence to agreed service hours.

* Outbound calls completed.

* Meaningful customer conversations.

* Decision-makers contacted.

* Follow-ups completed.

* Qualified leads generated.

* Appointments generated.

* Estimates or quote opportunities generated.

* B2B opportunities developed.

* Sales opportunities moved forward.

* Quality and accuracy of Client Reach documentation.

* Professionalism when communicating with customers and prospects.

* Compliance with agreed processes and procedures.



Simply being logged into Client Reach, RingCentral, or another company system does not constitute completion of the contracted services.



The Contractor is expected to be **actively performing the agreed sales, calling, prospecting, and follow-up activities during the scheduled service hours**.



---



## 7. Weekly Invoicing & Payment Terms



The Contractor will be paid **weekly by invoice** for authorized services completed during the applicable week.



### Invoice Procedure



Invoices must always be submitted **after all scheduled working hours for that week have been completed**.



The Contractor may not submit an invoice in advance for hours or services that have not yet been completed.



The weekly process will be:



1. The Contractor completes all authorized service hours for the applicable week.

2. Once the week's scheduled services have been fully completed, the Contractor prepares the invoice.

3. The invoice must be
ed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

4. The invoice must include a **PayPal invoice/payment link** that allows Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. to make payment through PayPal.

5. Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. will review the invoice against the authorized hours and services completed.

6. Correct and approved invoices will normally be paid within **24–48 hours after the invoice has been received by
**.



### Invoice Requirements



Each weekly invoice must clearly include:



* Contractor's name or business name.

* Invoice number.

* Invoice date.

* Week/service period being invoiced.

* Authorized hours completed.

* Agreed hourly rate or contractor fee.

* Total amount due.

* Applicable taxes, if legally required.

* **PayPal invoice/payment link.**

* Any other information reasonably required for payment processing.



The invoice must accurately reflect the authorized services actually completed.



### When the Invoice Should Be Submitted



The regular service schedule is:



**Monday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Tuesday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Thursday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time



Therefore, the Contractor's weekly invoice should only be raised and submitted **after the Thursday shift has been fully completed**, unless Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. has approved a different arrangement in writing.



Invoices must not be raised on Monday or Tuesday for the full week because the remaining contracted services have not yet been completed.



### Payment Timeline



Once a correctly prepared invoice has been
ed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. and the week's authorized services have been completed, payment will normally be processed within **24–48 hours of receipt of the invoice**.



If an invoice contains incorrect hours, missing information, an incorrect amount, or does not include the required PayPal payment link, the Contractor may be asked to correct and resubmit the invoice.



In such cases, the 24–48 hour payment period will begin after the corrected invoice has been received and approved.



### No Advances



**Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. does not provide advances against future contractor fees, future working hours, or future invoices.**



This means:



* No invoices may be submitted for services that have not yet been completed.

* No advance payments will be made for future scheduled hours.

* No advances against future invoices will be provided.

* No personal loans will be provided.

* No early payment will be made for services that have not yet been completed.



The Contractor acknowledges that this is a **post-service weekly invoicing arrangement**.



**Services are completed first. The invoice is submitted afterward. Approved payment is then processed within 24–48 hours of receipt.**



---



## 8. Independent Contractor Relationship



The Contractor is engaged as an **independent contractor and not as an employee of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.**



Nothing in this arrangement is intended to establish an employer-employee relationship, partnership, joint venture, or other relationship beyond the independent contractor engagement.



The Contractor is responsible for their own applicable taxes, filings, registrations, insurance, and other obligations associated with their independent contractor status, subject to applicable law.



---



## 9. Confidentiality & Company Information



The Contractor may receive access to confidential and commercially sensitive information belonging to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd., including:



* Customer names and contact information.

* Lead databases.

* Customer requirements.

* Pricing.

* Supplier information.

* Business partner information.

* Sales strategies.

* Call scripts.

* Marketing information.

* Internal business processes.

* Login credentials.

* CRM information.

* Recorded communications.

* Company documents and data.



All company and customer information remains confidential and must only be used for authorized Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. business purposes.



The Contractor must not copy, download, distribute, disclose, sell, retain, transfer, or use company or customer information for personal purposes or for another business.



Upon completion or termination of the engagement, the Contractor must immediately cease accessing company systems.



Access to Client Reach, RingCentral,
, and other company systems may be removed immediately upon completion or termination of the contract.



Any confidential company or customer information in the Contractor's possession must be returned or permanently deleted as instructed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.



---



## 10. Position Summary



**Role:** Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor

**Company:** Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

**Relationship:** Independent Contractor

**Initial Trial:** 4 Weeks – Week-to-Week

**Potential Continued Contract:** Approximately 3–6 Months

**Commitment:** 12 Hours Per Week

**Days:** Monday, Tuesday & Thursday

**Service Hours:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time

**Location:** Remote

**Payment:** Weekly Upon Submission of Invoice

**Payment Method:** PayPal Invoice/Payment Link

**Payment Processing:** Normally Within 24–48 Hours of Receiving a Correct Invoice

**Primary Systems:** Client Reach & RingCentral

**Primary Focus:** Outbound Calling, Lead Generation, Customer Follow-Up & Appointment Setting



---



## 11. Important Terms & Conditions



By accepting this engagement, the Contractor acknowledges and agrees that:

title: Meta Ads Video Editor — DTC Product Launch (US market)
description:
Are you a video editor who can turn one 10-second clip into 12 testable ad variants — and knows why that matters more than the edit itself?



We're launching Lielow in the US: a bean bag you carry like a tote. You put it on the ground, sit on your towel, and lean back on it. 1.8 lbs, arrives already filled, four colourways. It's proven in Portugal — sold out ten times — and completely unknown in America.



We have ~80 raw clips, AI studio shots, and 8 finished ad scripts ready to edit. We need one editor to own the whole batch and every batch after it.



What You'll Be Doing

Editing 8 launch ads from finished scripts — shot list, timings, on-screen text and VO are all written for you. You cut, not concept.

Delivering every ad as a textless master + 3 hook-overlay versions, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. That's ~10 files per ad. This is the core of the job.

Building ads that work with the sound off — burned-in captions on every beat, product visible in frame one, cut on the action.

Turning around new hook variants and new batches weekly as we find out what works.

Working directly with the creative director on what's converting and what to cut.



Requirements

Proven Meta /
 ads editing — not TikTok organic. If your reel is trending-audio edits, this isn't the role.

You already know: no CapCut watermarks, no unlicensed trending audio, text in the middle third only, light grade (Meta compression destroys heavy LUTs), first frame = thumbnail.

Fast and consistent at volume. We'd rather have 12 good variants this week than 3 perfect ones next week.

Comfortable with burned-in captions, clean type, and matching an existing brand look.

Strong English — the ads are for US consumers and the copy is written in US English.

Reliable async communication and clear file naming. We ship on a schedule.



Nice To Have

eCommerce / DTC / Shopify brand experience

Basic graphic design (statics and carousels) — we need those too

Experience editing founder/UGC talking-head content



Why Join Us

Ground floor of a US launch. You'll see every result — hook rate, CTR, cost per purchase — on the ads you cut.

Every ad you make has a written hypothesis. You'll learn direct-response creative properly, not by guessing.

Ongoing work, not a one-off batch. We test weekly and we don't stop.

Performance bonus on creatives that win.



To Apply, Send:

2–3 paid ads you edited — not organic content. Tell us the platform and, if you know it, how they performed.

A one-line answer: why does an ad need to work with the sound off?

Your hourly rate, and how many hours you have available per week.

Put "Montauk" in your application title.

Paid test before we hire: we'll send you one raw clip and one script. You deliver a 10-second cut — textless master plus two hook versions, 9:16 and 4:5. Paid at your quoted rate.

description:

title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator Custom Artwork /

Sports Apparel / Illustration / Seamless Patterns



$12–$20 USD/hour | Long-Term | Approximately 15–25 Hours/Week



We are looking for an exceptionally creative, senior-level graphic

designer and illustrator to join our team on an ongoing freelance basis.



CREATIVITY IS THE #1 REQUIREMENT FOR THIS ROLE.



This is not primarily a production design position. We are not looking

for someone who simply places logos on templates, follows detailed

instructions, or waits to be told exactly what to create.



We need an outstanding visual designer who can be given very limited

creative direction and develop the idea themselves.



Your primary responsibility will be creating custom artwork and product

graphics based on customer logos, brands, themes, and design requests.



A typical project may begin with nothing more than:



A customer’s logo + a few colors + a short sentence describing what they

want.



From there, you are the creative.



You will be expected to determine the visual direction and create the

patterns, illustrations, icons, typography, supporting graphics,

layouts, and other artwork necessary to turn that limited information

into an exceptional finished collection.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



-   Interpret customer requests with very little creative direction

-   Develop original visual concepts independently

-   Create original graphics and artwork for apparel and other products

-   Design cohesive collections across multiple products

-   Determine how artwork should merchandise across different products

    rather than simply repeating the same design

-   Create original vector illustrations, icons, badges, logos,

    typography, and supporting artwork

-   Create sophisticated seamless repeating patterns

-   Work with customer logos and existing brand assets

-   Recreate low-resolution customer logos as clean vector artwork when

    necessary

-   Develop artwork specifically for sublimated sports/performance

    apparel

-   Adapt creative concepts across apparel, accessories, and other

    products

-   Use AI intelligently to accelerate portions of the creative process

    when appropriate

-   Take feedback well and quickly develop revised creative solutions



CREATIVITY IS ESSENTIAL



We cannot emphasize this enough.



We are looking for someone with excellent taste, strong visual

instincts, and the ability to generate ideas independently.



If you require detailed creative briefs, sketches, or step-by-step

instructions before you can begin designing, this will not be the right

position for you.



We want someone who can look at a customer’s brand, understand its

personality, and think:



“Here are five interesting directions we could take this.”



Not:



“What exactly would you like me to make?”



You should be comfortable making creative decisions yourself and

presenting strong solutions rather than waiting for someone else to

solve the creative problem for you.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL



You must be an exceptional Adobe Illustrator user.



You should be able to work quickly and confidently with complex vector

artwork without assistance.



You must have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.



We will train you on our internal processes. We will not train you on

design software.



Illustration — STRONG/EXPERT



You must actually be able to illustrate.



This includes creating:



-   Original vector graphics

-   Icons

-   Logos and badges

-   Custom typography

-   Mascots/characters when needed

-   Graphic elements

-   Pattern assets

-   Supporting collection artwork



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is arranging stock

assets.



Seamless Patterns — ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED



You must know how to professionally create seamless repeating patterns

in:



Adobe Illustrator AND Adobe Photoshop.



This is a core requirement of the position.



Sports / Sublimated Apparel Experience



You should have professional experience designing for sports,

performance, or sublimated apparel.



Experience with categories such as golf, cycling, running, outdoor, team

sports, or similar products is highly desirable.



You must understand how artwork interacts with garment panels and how to

design a collection that works across multiple product types.



AI EXPERIENCE



We actively use AI as a creative accelerator, and you should be

comfortable doing the same.



You should understand how to use modern AI creative tools to help:



-   Explore concepts

-   Generate reference material

-   Develop supporting assets

-   Accelerate illustration

-   Explore compositions

-   Generate ideas faster



However, the finished work cannot look AI-generated.



AI is a tool—not a substitute for design ability.



You must have the taste and technical ability to recognize poor AI

output, refine/rebuild assets when necessary, and turn generated ideas

into polished, professional artwork.



A great designer using AI should become faster and more capable, not

produce generic AI artwork.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



-   Extremely creative

-   A genuinely strong visual problem solver

-   A senior-level designer, not someone still learning their craft

-   An excellent illustrator

-   Highly self-sufficient

-   Fast in Adobe Illustrator

-   Comfortable starting with very limited direction

-   Able to take constructive feedback without becoming dependent on

    direction

-   Capable of switching between completely different visual styles

-   Excellent at color, typography, composition, and pattern

-   Able to understand a brand quickly

-   Organized and reliable

-   Comfortable managing multiple custom projects

-   Excited about making genuinely cool artwork



Creativity and portfolio quality matter more to us than years of

experience or formal education.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



This is intended to become a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Our target is approximately 25 hours per week at $12–$15 USD/hour,

depending on experience, speed, and portfolio quality.



However:



We are willing to pay up to $20 USD/hour for an exceptional designer,

even if that means fewer guaranteed weekly hours.



We would rather have 15–20 hours from an incredible designer than 25

hours from an average one.



During busy periods, there may also be opportunities to take on

additional projects/hours for additional compensation or performance

bonuses, based on availability.



PORTFOLIO REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS



Do not apply without a portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



We especially want to see:



-   Your most creative work

-   Sports/performance apparel graphics

-   Sublimated apparel

-   Complete coordinated collections

-   Seamless patterns

-   Original vector illustration

-   Logos, badges, and icons you personally created

-   Projects where you developed the creative direction yourself



We are not particularly interested in portfolios dominated by social

media graphics, corporate presentations, UI/UX, Canva templates, or

generic branding projects.



We want to see ARTWORK.



TO APPLY



Please include:



1.  Portfolio link — REQUIRED

2.  Show us the 3 projects that best demonstrate how creative you are.

3.  Show us a sports/apparel collection you personally designed.

4.  Show us at least 2 seamless patterns you personally built and tell

    us what software you used to create them.

5.  Show us examples of your original vector illustration work.

6.  Describe your experience with sublimated apparel.

7.  Tell us which AI creative tools you currently use and how they fit

    into your design process.

8.  Confirm that you have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.

9.  Confirm your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.



FINAL CREATIVE QUESTION:



Imagine a customer gives you only their logo, brand colors, and the

words “retro tropical golf.” They want a collection but provide no

additional creative direction.



Briefly describe the first 3 visual concepts you would explore.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.

Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.

**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.
